alchemy_make_compounds.title: Test Tube Basics
alchemy_make_compounds.desc: Get your hands on a Test Tube to figure out how to make Groddlene and Spriggase. Here are your hints: 6-3-0-0 and 11-7-5-0. There are many more to discover after that, but you'll be on your own. Remember that if you throw in a lot of everything, you have a good chance of finding something ...
alchemy_make_compounds.offer: Alchemy, eh? A Test Tube? Hmmm ...Get ready to do some experimentation: this one is a little different. You'll have to find the right combinations.There are only four elements, but there are many ratios and combinations. Figure out how to make Groddlene and Spriggase and the rest will follow.
alchemy_make_compounds.completion: You did it! Good! But there are many more to discover. 4-3-2-1? 17-7-4-2? 12-0-4-3? Don't worry, you'll get them all ...

alchemy_make_metal_ingots.title: Rub Eleven Out
alchemy_make_metal_ingots.desc: Plain metal is good. Fancy metal is better. Using Alchemical Tongs, alchemify Plain Metal into 11 Ingots each of Tin, Copper, and Molybdenum.
alchemy_make_metal_ingots.offer: Now that you're learning your way around the elements, are you ready to try your hand at some metalspawning? Get yourself some Alchemical Tongs, and a pile of Plain Metal. Then rub yourself up 11 Ingots each of Tin, Copper, and Molybdenum. Yes?
alchemy_make_metal_ingots.completion: By my count - and I'm always right about these things - it looks like you've alchemated up 11 ingots each of Tin, Copper and Molybdenum. <split butt_txt="Please make with the applause." /> Nothing says applause like cold, hard compensation. Here you go.

amazing_race.title: The Amazing Race
amazing_race.desc: Be the first to get to the top!
amazing_race.offer: Be the first to get to the top!

an_autumn_day.title: An Autumn Day
an_autumn_day.offer: As you may or may not know, many choices lack a right or wrong answer. <split butt_txt="Say what?" />The Giants have decided a great many things. Their decisions form our experience. <split butt_txt="Magical!" /> Just between you and I, I don't think this is unique to the Giants alone. Would you like to try something new?
an_autumn_day.completion: Did you enjoy yourself, {pc_label}? I thought you could benefit from that experience. Talk to you later, and next time perhaps your decision will have a different outcome.
an_autumn_day.offerNote: street spirit giver; offered once A Summer’s Day is done

an_autumn_day_part2.title: An Autumn Day
an_autumn_day_part2.offer: Are you ready to reminisce An Autumn Day?
an_autumn_day_part2.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.
an_autumn_day_part2.offerNote: street spirit giver; canOffer: an hour after part 1 and after the last repeat

animal_friend.title: Animal friend
animal_friend.desc: Pet an animal in every hub of the world.
animal_friend.offer:
Hey kid! It's time to embark on a great journey. There are a lot of animals in the wild out there. They need some love, love of someone like you. 

Visit every hub in the world and pet at least one animal in each of them.
animal_friend.completion: That was a great journey, wasn't it? You saw a lot, you did good. And those animals you petted, I bet they were happy. The world is a better place now because of you.

animal_qrazy.title: Animal Q-razy
animal_qrazy.desc: Take a picture that contains exactly 2 Chickens, 3 Piggies and 2 Butterflies.
animal_qrazy.offer: Capturing things in motion - that's an art! Let's see if you can fine-tune your timing. Capture 2 Chickens, 3 Piggies and 2 Butterflies in one snap.Confidence, kid! It's all about confidence. Hint: your zoom might help!
animal_qrazy.completion: See, that's what I'm talking 'bout<split butt_txt="Pretty snappy, huh?" />Oof. Even I wouldn't make that pun. Here's your loot!

animalhusbandry_make_three_eggs.title: Three Eggs, One Basket
animalhusbandry_make_three_eggs.desc: Create 1 Piggy Egg, 1 Chicken Egg and 1 Butterfly Egg using an Egg Seasoner.
animalhusbandry_make_three_eggs.offer: Hey, kid. You like eggs, right? Whoa. Hey. No need to overcompensate. Happens to the best of us, kid. Now, you know where eggs come from, I hope? I deserved that. OK, so here's what I need you to do. Harvest three Plain Eggs. Then use an exciting mix of porcine, poultry and lepidopteral spices to transform three Plain Eggs into 1 Pig Egg, 1 Chicken Egg and 1 Butterfly Egg. So you don't know everything, do you, kid? Plain Eggs can be seasoned using spices, gases, bubbles and other stuff. I could, but I won't. Go figure it out, kid. It'll be fun!
animalhusbandry_make_three_eggs.completion: I knew you could do it, kid. Now did you know that seasoned eggs can be incubated under chickens? <split butt_txt="Tell me more!" />Another time, kid. Another time.

animalkinship_1.title: A L'il Animal Kinship
animalkinship_1.desc: Learn how to please, and then harvest from the animals of Ur.
animalkinship_1.offer: Now that’s what we like to see around here: someone who appreciates the winged of this world. We’ll get into the details later, but there’s a little Butterfly Lotion in it for ya. You in the mood for some animal lovin’?
animalkinship_1.completion: Petting? Nibbling? You’re well on your way now, kid. Congrats!

animalkinship_massage_butterflies.title: Happy Endings For All!
animalkinship_massage_butterflies.desc: Catch yourself 7 Butterflies and ease their tired little wings with a bit of healthful massage. You'll need Butterfly Lotion, sold at Animal Goods Vendors or the auction house.
animalkinship_massage_butterflies.offer: You know, on some worlds, I could be arrested for my next suggestion. First you'll need some Butterfly Lotion. And then you'll want to find yourself 7 Butterflies, and give them the Calgon-take-me-away treatment. It's not done until it's done, mon frere.
animalkinship_massage_butterflies.completion: Those 7 Butterflies will have to look long and hard for another massage the likes of those.  <split butt_txt="My fingers are magic." /> Well then, my magic-fingered magoo, I guess you're probably above a little reward. <split butt_txt="That is incorrect." /> It always is.

animalkinship_max_nibble_milk_squeeze.title: Nibble, Milk and Squeeze TO THE MAX
animalkinship_max_nibble_milk_squeeze.desc: Get the maximum yield from a Piggy, a Butterfly and a Chicken.
animalkinship_max_nibble_milk_squeeze.offer: Hey, friend. Feeling fecund? Good. Have you ever noticed how, when you're out there nibbling Piggies, milking Butterflies and squeezing Chickens, sometimes you get better results than other times? To do this job, you need to go and get the maximum yield from a Piggy, a Butterfly and a Chicken. Goldurned if I know, kid. They're critters of whimsy. Good luck!
animalkinship_max_nibble_milk_squeeze.completion: Howdy, kid. I see that you've left no piggy un-nibbled... no butterfly un-milked... no chicken un-squee- <split butt_txt="Yup, uh-huh, I get it." /> Can't a rock finish a sentence around here? <split butt_txt="Sorry." /> What I was ABOUT to say is: here's your reward. And start practicing your finger exercises for your next job. It's going to be a doozy.

animalkinship_milk_butterflies.title: Go Moloko Loco, Butterfly Style
animalkinship_milk_butterflies.desc: Find and gently milk 13 different Butterflies in one little old game day. Don't forget to use Butterfly Lotion.
animalkinship_milk_butterflies.offer: So, how are you with Butterflies? Then you should have no trouble milking 13 of the little nectar nippers, no? Whoa. Not so fast, bub. This job has to get done in one game day, got it? And don't forget to use Butterfly Lotion. You don't want those wee udders to chafe. You can get Butterfly Lotion from any Street Spirit who sells Animal Goods.
animalkinship_milk_butterflies.completion: Now there's something you don't see every day. Those butterflies is thoroughly milked. <split butt_txt="I squoze 'em good." /> I can see that. As promised, here's a little something-something. Get yourself something pretty.

animalkinship_name_animals.title: Doin' the Ol' MacDonald
animalkinship_name_animals.desc: Form an extra special bond with some of your animal friends. Name one Piggy and one Butterfly.
animalkinship_name_animals.offer: How would you like to really get to know one Piggy and one Butterfly in an extra special way? That wasn't a double entendre. Leave my subtext out of this. All I'm trying to do is get you to name a Piggy and a Butterfly, It will be a very rewarding experience. Just go.
animalkinship_name_animals.completion: So those are the names, eh? <split butt_txt="Is there a problem?" /> No, no. It's not like they have to go to elementary school with names like that. You've earned every bit of this.

animalkinship_nibble_meat.title: Get a Rasher
animalkinship_nibble_meat.desc: Successfully obtain 13 Meat from 13 Piggies, all in one nibbly game day.
animalkinship_nibble_meat.offer: Piggies are smarter than dogs you know. Er, never mind that now. Just find yourself 13 different Piggies, and nibble them ever so gently to get 13 Meat. And don't forget to pet them first. Just because they're animals doesn't mean they don't appreciate the niceties.
animalkinship_nibble_meat.completion: Wow. Thirteen piggies nibbled in one day. That is a lot of Meats. <split butt_txt="What can I say?" />You can say "Nice job, self!" Here's a little something. Go buy yourself some shopping things.

animalkinship_pet_piggies.title: Porcine Pleaser
animalkinship_pet_piggies.desc: Give 6 Piggies the pleasuring of a lifetime. By petting them, of course.
animalkinship_pet_piggies.offer: How are your hands feeling today, kid? Strong? Yet gentle? Good. Our Piggies are feeling sad. Neglected. In need of some firm but loving TLC. Flex those finger muscles and pet the first 6 Piggies you meet. Ready?
animalkinship_pet_piggies.completion: Those are some thoroughly pleasured Piggies, friend. That was some good petting. <split butt_txt="I did my best." /> And it shows. As a little token of appreciation, they asked me to give you this.

animalkinship_squeeze_chicken_for_drop.title: Chicken Music Block Combo
animalkinship_squeeze_chicken_for_drop.desc: Squeeze Chicken after Chicken until one of them pops out a Music Block. It sounds unlikely, to be sure, but it will happen.
animalkinship_squeeze_chicken_for_drop.offer: Psst. Hey, kid. You like music? You like chickens? Don't panic. Nothing weird. Just get out there and squeeze a few Chickens until one of them pops out a Music Block. You go, kid.
animalkinship_squeeze_chicken_for_drop.completion: Hey! I see from your brand-new music block that there's a happy chicken out there somewhere.<split butt_txt="You see rightly." /> A well-squeezed chicken is its own reward, but here's a little something-something for you anyway.

baqala_nostalgia.title: Baqalic Caesura
baqala_nostalgia.desc: Collect three Glitchian ancestral remnants from devilishly-difficult-to-predict snapping dust traps along the roadside.
baqala_nostalgia.offer:
Whoa, kid. Are you OK? 
<split butt_txt="Ouch.">
Seriously, you just went all pale. 
<split butt_txt="My heart hurts all of a sudden.">
That's called nostalgia, kid. Welcome to the savanna. Millions of years ago, these sun-blasted plains were where the giants imagined some of your predecessors out of the stygian depths of antediluvian mind-stuff… 
<split butt_txt="Huh?"> 
What you're feeling is the weight of aeons pressing on your heart. 
<split butt_txt="I can't tell if I like it or not.">
It's supposed to feel like that, kid, but don't stay too long – your overwhelminess will force you to flee to safety, unless…
<split butt_txt="Unless what?">
Unless you can find a tangible way to connect to your ancestors. This place used to be teeming with them. They must have left some remnants. I'm talking microscopic, though, teeny-tiny bits and bobs: the golgi apparatus, endoplasmic reticula, vacuoles, super old mitochondrial DNA, the pileated gibbon…
<split butt_txt="Isn't that some kind of ape?"> 
Whatever. The dust traps that snap on the streets round here usually shake something loose. Try to find as many of those as you can, and I bet you can hold on to that feeling for a little bit longer. And if you can find three of them, I might have something extra for you. 
<split butt_txt="OK, I'll do it!">
Just be careful out here—a group of mean-spirited mothers calling themselves the Juju Bandits have claimed the savanna as their own, and they don't take too kindly to strangers.
baqala_nostalgia.completion: Colour me impressed. You've got pretty sharp eyes to spot three of those wee-tiny remnants in all this dust.<split butt_txt="Does that mean I can stay?">For a little while, and collecting even more remnants will help you stay for a little longer still, but I'm afraid nothing lasts forever.

batterfly_bounty.title: Batterfly Bounty Booster
batterfly_bounty.desc: Help the Rock to discover how much guano you can get from a batterfly.
batterfly_bounty.offer: Ever wish you could get a bit more outta those batterflies? That guano is worth its weight in currants! Right, let's see how much guano you can get from a batterfly. Find yourself a piggy and give it a pet and nibble for some meat. Then feed the meat to a batterfly roaming the caves.
batterfly_bounty.completion: Hmm. That wasn't as much guano as I'd hoped for, but it reminded me of an old recipe I saw in a book once.

batterfly_bounty_part2.title: Batterfly Bounty Booster II
batterfly_bounty_part2.desc: Learn a long forgotten recipe that could get you more guano from those reclusive batterflies.
batterfly_bounty_part2.offer: This recipe looks promising. To be safe you probably shouldn't eat any yourself though. Those ingredients could really foul up your mood. Okay then, grab your Awesome Pot and whip up a batch of Batterfly Bounty Booster Bars and try feeding one to a batterfly.
batterfly_bounty_part2.completion: Nicely done! I guess you can believe some of what you read. <split butt_txt="Seems so." />Take note: there was a warning in the margin of the book. NEVER make more than one bar per day. It's too potent. <split butt_txt="Understood." />

requirements.name: r407
requirements.desc: Make a Batterfly Bounty Booster Bar

beer_guzzle.title: The Great Guzzler Challenge
beer_guzzle.desc: Drink a dozen Beers. Shotgunning is optional.
beer_guzzle.offer: Hey, kid. I know this is going to sound like a weird request, but it's really important that you find and drink 12 Beers. Or is it 12 Beer? You don't say? Well. Anyway. Are you up for it? Then hop to it! What? Hop... hops... beer. Get it? Give me a break, kid. I'm a rock. Are you going to do this thing or what?
beer_guzzle.completion: Well done, kid. You chugged that like a pro. Here's a little something to make it worth your while. <split butt_txt="Thanks. *hiccup*" />Maybe you should go lie down or something. You don't look so good.

betterlearning_collect_favor_points.title: Favor Curry
betterlearning_collect_favor_points.desc: Visit your favorite Shrine and give until it hurts. Or until you get 100 favor points. Whichever comes first. (Weaselly small print: Shrines where you've already earned 100 favor points don't count.)
betterlearning_collect_favor_points.offer: You know, friend, in this crazy hardscrabble old world, we need all the help we can get. True, true. Which is why I'm proposing that you get out there and work on currying extra favor with the Giants. The best way to do it is to pick your favorite Shrine, then donate to it. The better your donation, the more favor points you get. And when you earn 100 points at the Shrine of your choice, there'll be a little bonus for you. Sound good?
betterlearning_collect_favor_points.completion: Well done. You gave and you gave, and it looked like it didn't even hurt. <split butt_txt="It hurt a little." /> I've got a little something special for you that should take that pain away. <split butt_txt="Thanks!" /> Now what are you going to do with all those favor points? <split butt_txt="Do?" /> Oh, yeah. Didn't you know? You can spend your points to speed up how quickly you learn different skills. Accelerated edumacation. Go get some.

betterlearning_donate_to_shrines.title: Shriner's Convention
betterlearning_donate_to_shrines.desc: Get to know your neighborhood Shrines. Donate to the shrines of 5 different Giants.
betterlearning_donate_to_shrines.offer: The Giants, praise their neural clusters, don't ask for much. Nothing, in fact. But it never hurts to suck up to the boss a little, am I right? Well, okay then. Keep those crazy eyes of yours peeled for Shrines, and donate to the shrines of 5 different Giants. And don't cheap out. The Giants know what lurks within your heart.
betterlearning_donate_to_shrines.completion: You did it! <split butt_txt="I did it! What did I do?" /> Remember? Your quest to donate to all of those Shrines? <split butt_txt="That's right. I did do it!" />You're a little slow, kid, but I like you. And I'm not the only one. Here's something to put in your doodad collection.

betterlearning_get_favor_at_shrines.title: Spreading the Love
betterlearning_get_favor_at_shrines.desc: Get 23 favor points at the Shrines of five different Giants by donating to them. (Only the stuff donated from this moment onward counts.)
betterlearning_get_favor_at_shrines.offer: Hey, don't panic, kid, but… Well, I've heard a rumour that you've been favoring some Giants over others. Well, I'd advise you to repair your reputation, and fast. You want to know how? Watch the sarcasm, chummo. Get yourself to the Shrines of five different Giants, and donate... oof, counting from this moment onward, at least 23 favor points-worth of stuff to all of them? Yeah, that should do it. Git, kid!
betterlearning_get_favor_at_shrines.completion: Phew. I think everyone feels like you're spreading your favor a little more evenly. <split butt_txt="Phew." /> And just for that, here I am, spreading MY love, all over you, very evenly. In the form of remuneration and stuff. This isn't coming out right at all.

requirements.name: favor_unique_shrines
requirements.desc: Donate at least 23 favor worth of items to the Shrines of 5 different Giants.

betterlearning_get_giant_emblem.title: Automagically Emblematical
betterlearning_get_giant_emblem.desc: Donate to your favorite Giant's Shrine until you get an Emblem. The first Emblem is awarded at 1000 favor points.
betterlearning_get_giant_emblem.offer: Emblem. It's a weird-looking word, don't you think? The more you look at it, the less sense it makes. And it's even weirder when you say it out loud. Be that as it may, you should get one. An Emblem, I mean. Pick a Shrine and donate until you get 1000 favor points. Then you'll earn an Emblem. It'll be awesome. Trust me.
betterlearning_get_giant_emblem.completion: And that's how you earn an Emblem. Now that you have it, you can trade it in for all kinds of excellent learning-related bonuses. If I told you everything, what would be the fun of that?

betterlearning_spend_favor_with_primary_.title: Under the Wire
betterlearning_spend_favor_with_primary_.desc: Identify the Primary Giant of a skill you want to learn, and donate until you have at least 997 favor points at that Giant's Shrine (but not enough to get an Emblem). Then spend them ALL AT ONCE on speeding up your skill-learning. (Tip: The skill will need to have more than 6 hours of learning left to make this possible. And spending an Emblem doesn't count).
betterlearning_spend_favor_with_primary_.offer: The Giants, all power to their spectral neurons, are most pleased when you learn their specialist skills, you know. Oh, totally. All skills are aligned to Giants, and one Giant, the Primary Giant, is always more closely aligned than others. So it's worth sucking up more to them than others. If I were you, and I'm not, but if I was, I'd donate to get almost as much favor as I could for the giant of a skill I was learning - say… 997 favor points? And then spend them in one go speeding up that learnin'. That's what I'd do. That's what I thought. Do it. See you in 997 favor points, kid.
betterlearning_spend_favor_with_primary_.completion: Phew! thought you were going to over-donate and earn yourself an extra Emblem for a second there, small. <split butt_txt="Tsh. I know better than that." /> Course you do, kid. And that's the life lesson here: know your limits, and fall juuuuuust short of 'em. And that way, you get the big rewards! Wait. That sounds wrong. Oh, whatever, kid: Ta da!!!

requirements.name: primary_giant_spend_mad_favor
requirements.desc: Spend 997 favor points with a skill's Primary Giant.

betterlearning_spend_huge_favor.title: This Favor Goes Up to 11. Or 1511
betterlearning_spend_huge_favor.desc: Spend 1511 favor points in one go speeding up skill learning. (Subtle Hinty-Nudge: collecting multiple Emblems from one Giant will increase your favor capacity…)
betterlearning_spend_huge_favor.offer: You believe there's such thing as too much of a good thing, kid. Darn tootin'. And you know what counts as a really good thing? Those glorious little Emblems you get from donating to Giants. Oh yes. Your favor limit with a Giant increases with each subsequent Emblem. So multiple Emblems make for bigtime favor capacity, as my grandmother used to say. But she never elaborated. So try something for me, will ya? Collect as many Emblems as it takes to increase your favor capacity to 1600. Then accrue 1511 favor points for whichever Giant you please. Yup, 1511. Then spend them all at once on speeding up learning a skill. Which skill? Well, I'll leave that up to you. I'm easy like that.
betterlearning_spend_huge_favor.completion: You know how they say diligence is its own reward? Well, that's only half of it. Because not only did you get ultraspeedy edumacation and the lasting admiration of your giant, but, ta da! A little clutch of thingamyjigs from me to you. You're welcome, kid.

blending_make_level1_recipes.title: Juice Medley Melee
blending_make_level1_recipes.desc: Use a Blender to make a Fruity Juice, a Lemon Juice, and an Orange Juice. Hold the pulp.
blending_make_level1_recipes.offer: Hey, kid. I feel a touch of the scurvy coming on. Can you hook me up with some juice? I don't know if you've noticed this yet, kid, but I'm not quite like other rocks. So scurvy. Capiche? So could you get yourself a Blender and whip me up some Fruity Juice. Not so fast. And a Lemon Juice. Hold on. And an Orange Juice. And what? That's it. Wait a second, kid. One last thing. Hold the pulp.
blending_make_level1_recipes.completion: That juice looks mighty bracing, kid. But I forgot something. <split butt_txt="Yeah?" />I can't drink it. <split butt_txt="But you said..." />Forget what I said. I'm a rock. I say a lot of things. But here. For being such a good sport, I'm going to give you an extra-big reward. <split butt_txt="Wow, thanks!" />One thing, though. <split butt_txt="What's that?" />I see pulp.

blending_make_level2_recipes.title: Get into a Froth
blending_make_level2_recipes.desc: A-blendering you will go. Use your twin-engine Blender to whip up a Too-Berry Shake, an Earthshaker and a Bubble Tea.
blending_make_level2_recipes.offer: So, chum, you think you're getting the hang of that there Blender? Juice, schmuice. The real test of a blenderer's mettle is the ability to make fancy drinks. I had a feeling you'd say that. Whip up a Too-Berry Shake, an Earthshaker and a Bubble Tea. Then we'll talk.
blending_make_level2_recipes.completion: Well, well, well. A-blendering you certainly did go. I like the extra froth you put on the Too-Berry Shake. And are those extra bubbles in that Bubble Tea? It's these little extra touches that tell me you're gonna go far, kid. Speaking of little extra touches, here's the usual little something for your trouble.

block_party.title: Block Party
block_party.desc: Prove your blockmakery by making three Urth Blocks.
block_party.offer: Ah, Blockmaking. A good, honest skill, lad. Lass? Lad? Whatever. I've never understood the difference with you lot. ANYWAY. It's good honest labor, blockmaking. Hard day's work for a… well, sense of satisfaction of a job done well. A skilled blockmaker is always in demand. So you'd better hone your trade.Ah, kids these days. No: make me three Urth Blocks, just to prove your skill. Will you do it?
block_party.completion: I take back what I said, kid. These are some mighty fine blocks. <split butt_txt="Why, thank you." /> It seems you might be a born Blockmaker after all. And for that, I'll take a slice of humble pie, and you can have a little reward.

blue_and_white_part1.title: A Summer's Day
blue_and_white_part1.offer: Yes. Good. Here it is: there's a certain memory of a summer's day shared by all the Giants. <split butt_txt="Yes?" />None of them remember what happened or even why they remember it... yet they do. <split butt_txt="Interesting" />It is just an impression, a feeling. Maybe it is important, maybe it is not. <split butt_txt="OK" />Would you like to go there now and see what you think?
blue_and_white_part1.completion: You see, {pc_label}? I thought you could benefit from that experience. No one knows what it means, so let your imagination go wild.

blue_and_white_part2.title: A Summer's Day
blue_and_white_part2.offer: Are you ready to reminisce A Summer's Day?
blue_and_white_part2.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.

bogspecialization_harvest_full_peat_bog_.title: Peter out Peat
bogspecialization_harvest_full_peat_bog_.desc: Grab your Shovel and wrangle some friends to help you harvest a full Peat Bog until it's empty. In less than 9 seconds.
bogspecialization_harvest_full_peat_bog_.offer: Greetings, my round-headed friend. I have a job for you. Use your Shovel to harvest a full Peat Bog until it's empty. In 9 seconds. Did I mention you can invite some friends to help you? Better now?
bogspecialization_harvest_full_peat_bog_.completion: Congratulations. You and your confreres harvested this entire bog in less than 9 seconds. <split butt_txt="I say Boo. And also Ya." /> Unfortunately, I've only got enough on me to reward just you. <split butt_txt="Oh." /> Might I recommend a round of heartfelt high-fives?

botany_make_tree_beans.title: Advanced Bean Fancification
botany_make_tree_beans.desc: Use a Bean Seasoner to transform two Plain Beans into two different kinds of Seasoned Beans. Hint: You're going to need other ingredients to do this. Get them from Street Spirits or your friends.
botany_make_tree_beans.offer: Consider the Bean, kid. I mean, your basic bean is all right. But here's what I want you to do. Get yourself two Plain Beans. Get yourself a Bean Seasoner. And then make two different kinds of Seasoned Beans. You look ready, kid. One last thing: you're going to need to mess around with other ingredients to do this. Buy them, harvest them, or get them from friends. It doesn't matter which, just make sure you get them.
botany_make_tree_beans.completion: That was some mighty impressive Bean Seasoning, kid. I shouldn't say this, but I haven't seen such fine Beans since the days when Spriggan himself was seasoning them by hand. <split butt_txt="Wow. I don't know what to say." />Then don't say anything. Always a good call.

brain_freezer.title: Brain Freezer
brain_freezer.desc: You know what's better than a Sno Cone? Five Sno Cones! Collect one of each color: Blue, Green, Orange, Red and Purple. Get them from your friends, from a Sno Cone Vendor in Wintry Place (accessible via Northwest Passage in Groddle Forest or Newcot Close in Groddle Heights) or from the Auctions.
brain_freezer.offer: Psst. Kid. It's been two million years since I burned through this atmosphere, but I'm still hot. Get me a Sno Cone, will you? Better yet, make that five Sno Cones. Remember, kid, five. That's one each of blue, green, orange, purple and red. And just so you know, unless you have friends with Sno Cones, it might be the easiest to visit the Wintry Place via Northwest Passage or Newcot Close to do this. And if you go to Wintry Place you're going to have to find a Sno Cone Vendor. Think you can manage all that?
brain_freezer.completion: Yoink! I'm taking all those Sno Cones. <split butt_txt="Huh?" /> Don't worry, kid. You deserve some kudos. <split butt_txt="Aww... shucks." />Unfortunately, I gave away my last kudo yesterday. Take some currants and points instead.

btc_room_3.title: An Old Fashioned B&E
btc_room_3.desc: Solve the maze using the ladders and buttons. Piece of Cheesecake! Okay, I lied about the cake …
btc_room_3.offer: Psst … I figured out how to get in. <split butt_txt="In where?" /> To the place! Do you want to sneak in, or not?!
btc_room_3.completion: Huh. I totally thought that place was a toy factory before. <split butt_txt="Why are you still whispering?" /> Oh right, thanks! You know, people say I spit when I whisper. But really, I just whisper when I spit.

btc_room_3_reminisce.title: An Old Fashioned B&E
btc_room_3_reminisce.desc: Solve the maze using the ladders and buttons. Piece of Cheesecake! Okay, I lied about the cake …
btc_room_3_reminisce.offer: Are you ready to reminisce An Old Fashioned B&E?
btc_room_3_reminisce.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.
btc_room_3_reminisce.offerNote: canOffer: an hour after part 1 and after the last repeat or fail

bubbletuning_transform_bubbles.title: Bubble Transmogrification
bubbletuning_transform_bubbles.desc: Harvest 28 Plain Bubbles and change them into 7 Tiny Bubbles and 7 Blue Bubbles. You'll need a Bubble Tuner, natch. You can buy a bubble tuner from a Street Spirit who sells Produce or Hardware.
bubbletuning_transform_bubbles.offer: So you want to get into the Bubble Tuning game, huh, kid? It's a from-the-ground-up operation. So let's start at the beginning. Harvest 28 Plain Bubbles and get yourself a Bubble Tuner. Use it to create 7 Tiny Bubbles and 7 Blue Bubbles. It's that easy. Ready?
bubbletuning_transform_bubbles.completion: Let me see those bubbles. Hmmm... nice curvature... good surface tension... decent viscosity. Not bad for a beginner.

build_a_tower.title: Build a Tower
build_a_tower.desc: Clear some space, cultivate a Tower, gather the requirements, and finish the project.
build_a_tower.offer: That's some darned fine building you've been doing, lil' Glitch. Your daddy a Mason or something?I dunno, was hoping you would know. I saw it in a movie once.Sigh... Anyway! The next thing you should build is a tower. A tower is a public building on your home street that you can decorate and show off to other players. Sounds awesome, right? Wanna do it?Alright, good. Go to your home street and Cultivate a Tower to get started.
build_a_tower.completion: Bigger, bigger, yeahhhhhhh. That looks so good, and you can make it even taller now! Here's a little something to get you started.

butler_zombies.title: Day of the Undead Butlers
butler_zombies.desc: Say "zombie" to 31 butlers in one game day.
butler_zombies.offer: Some people think the butlers are creepy. Well, I KNOW they're creepy.<split butt_txt="I think butlers are cute!" />Well, ok, we can agree to differ on that. But anyway, I want you to make them creepier.<split butt_txt="How?" />Go find 31 different butlers and give them a craving for brains. By which I mean, say the word "zombie" to each butler. ("Chat" to the butler to open an IM window.) <split butt_txt="Can do." /> Not so fast, Buffy. <split butt_txt="I thought you said zombies, not vampires." /> Whatever. It's all undead to me. Here's the catch: you have to do it all in one single game day.
butler_zombies.completion: Woah, the zombie apocalypse happened, and you caused it. Let's drink to braains!

buy_bag.title: Enlarge Yer Slots
buy_bag.desc: With only 16 places to put things, it is easy to run out of space. Go find any Street Spirit who sells Hardware and buy yourself a Generic Bag or a Bigger Bag.
buy_bag.offer: With only 16 places to put things, it is easy to run out of space. Go find any Street Spirit who sells Hardware and buy yourself a Generic Bag or a Bigger Bag.
buy_bag.completion: You got the bag: well done! I'm not even going to explain how you get things in it. I think you are smart enough to figure it out.<split butt_txt="Yeah! I am!" />On second thought ... drag stuff in to it. (I worry about you, kid.)<split butt_txt="Grrrr!" />Whatever ... here's some nice prizes for your trouble.

offerTriggers.why: early pack-space quest (source: emergency, newxp era)

buy_two_bags.title: Enlarge Yer Slots
buy_two_bags.desc: The Street Spirit over on Progress Way is a bag vendor who sells 'em cheap. Go find her and buy two bags.
buy_two_bags.offer: The Street Spirit over on Progress Way is a bag vendor who sells 'em cheap. Go find her and buy two bags.
buy_two_bags.completion: You got the bags: well done! I'm not even going to explain how you get things in them. I think you are smart enough to figure it out.<split butt_txt="Yeah! I am!" />Now head back to your Home Street and we'll wrap this tutorial up.<split butt_txt="Got it" />Oh yeah … here are some nice prizes for your trouble.

cal_test_1.title: Cal Test 1
cal_test_1.offer: I'd like you to collect some apples for me!

canyon_run.title: Canyon Run
canyon_run.desc: Be the first to get to the other side!
canyon_run.offer: Be the first to get to the other side!

card_carrying_qualification.title: Legalize It
card_carrying_qualification.desc: Obtain and activate the Card Carrying Qualification. You can get it at any one of the Bureaucratic Halls: Gregarious Grange in Groddle Meadow, Baeli Bray in Muufo, or Chego Chase in Andra. Hint: You can avoid the 'red tape' by acquiring it from other players or at an Auction.
card_carrying_qualification.offer: Pssst. As all respectable citizens know, you must have Your Papers in order to use public transportation. That's right, but before you can 'complete' Your Papers you need to get and 'activate' the Card Carrying Qualification. Perhaps. But, you're in luck. I know a guy who knows a guy that can help you with your problem. Interested?
card_carrying_qualification.completion: Congratulations! You have taken the first step toward Bureaucratic officialdom. As with all first steps, there is a second, a third … Once you learn Bureaucratic Arts I, then get and 'complete' Your Papers, you'll be able to use public transportation. Hint: You can also get Your Papers from other players or at Auction. Off you go!

cheffery_make_level1_recipes.title: Eggs 'n' Basics
cheffery_make_level1_recipes.desc: Use a Frying Pan to make Fried Eggs, a Basic Omelet and a Bun. It barely gets easier.
cheffery_make_level1_recipes.offer: Seems like a Frying Pan is suddenly quite the thing for you to own now. Because you now know Cheffery! Start off easy: Fried Eggs, then move up to a Basic Omelet and round it off with a Bun.
cheffery_make_level1_recipes.completion: Nice work, kid. You sure made those eggs 'n' basics. <split butt_txt="Thanks." />Cooking is usually its own reward, but in your case, I'm giving you a little something extra.

cheffery_make_level2_recipes.title: Eggy McWeggies
cheffery_make_level2_recipes.desc: Make some eggselent dishes. Use your Frying Pan to make 7 Mexicali Eggs, 11 Green Eggs and 15 Eggy Scrambles. And yes, eggselent is too a real word.
cheffery_make_level2_recipes.offer: Mmmmm. Eggs. Gotta love em. Right, kid? Well, let's put your Cheffery skills to work here and see what you can do. Grab your Frying Pan and go make 7 orders of Mexicali Eggs, 11 Green Eggs and 15 Eggy Scrambles.
cheffery_make_level2_recipes.completion: Saaaay. Those were some sweet smelling Eggy McWeggies you whipped up. <split butt_txt="Aw, thanks." />Especially that last dish of whatchamacallit. You could sell those. <split butt_txt="Well, shucks." />Here's a little reward you can put towards your future edumacation. You show promise, kid.

cheffery_make_level3_recipes.title: Down Home Cookin'
cheffery_make_level3_recipes.desc: Use your Frying Pan to whip up a batch of 7 dee-licious Bubble and Squeaks, and 11 scrumptious Corny Fritters.
cheffery_make_level3_recipes.offer: There is nothing, I say, nothing, better than down-home cookin'. Let's see what you can do with that old Frying Pan of yours. Whip up 7 batches of Bubble and Squeak, and 11 Corny Fritters.
cheffery_make_level3_recipes.completion: Well, I say. Bubble and Squeak AND Corny Fritters. You've done gone done some delectable home cooking. <split butt_txt="The secret ingredient is love." /> I can't tell you how much I hope you mean that in the figurative sense. Here's the traditional bonus reward.

chris_test.title: Chris Test Quest
chris_test.completion: U R WINNER, HA HA HA!

cocktailcrafting_make_level1_recipes.title: Shake and Stir
cocktailcrafting_make_level1_recipes.desc: Use a Cocktail Shaker to froth up 5 Creamy Martinis. Then drink them! Here's a tip: To make a Creamy Martini, you're going to have to milk some Butterflies.
cocktailcrafting_make_level1_recipes.offer: Kid, have I ever mentioned that you look like the daring, adventure-seeking type? And daring, adventure-seeking types like you need daring, adventurous drinks. That's why I think you're ready for this mixological adventure. Get yourself a Cocktail Shaker, then make and drink 5 Creamy Martinis. The creaminess comes from the Butterfly Milk. Or, specifically, how the butterfly milk reacts to the Onions. I can tell you're excited. Ready to get started?
cocktailcrafting_make_level1_recipes.completion: Those looked even tastier than usual. <split butt_txt="Yeah, they were better than I expected." />The secret is shaking AND stirring them. And then shaking them again. <split butt_txt="*blarp*" />That would be the onions.

cocktailcrafting_make_level2_recipes.title: Bartending with Yourself... Oh Oh Oh, Bartending with Yourself
cocktailcrafting_make_level2_recipes.desc: Make, and also drink, both a Cloudberry Daiquiri and a Cosma-politan.
cocktailcrafting_make_level2_recipes.offer: Ever taste a cloud, kid? I have. It's like eating an angel while it's still warm. Next best thing is a Cloudberry Daiquiri. Show yourself what kind of bartender you are. Make, and also drink, both a Cloudberry Daiquiri and a Cosma-politan. I'll check in with you when you're done.
cocktailcrafting_make_level2_recipes.completion: Whoa! You smell like my Uncle Doug. How'd that Cloudberry Daiquiri and Cosma-politan treat you? <split butt_txt="They'll do." /> Party in a pair of pants, that's you. Here's a little something for your next clambake. Hasta banana, kid.

cocktailcrafting_make_level3_recipes.title: Barista La Vista
cocktailcrafting_make_level3_recipes.desc: Make 1 of each type of the following cocktail drinks with your cocktail shaker: Creamy Martini, Mabbish Coffee, Spicy Grog, Carrot Margarita, Cloudberry Daiquiri, Gurly Drink, Slow Gin Fizz, Cosma-politan, Flaming Humbaba, Pungent Sunrise, Face Smelter
cocktailcrafting_make_level3_recipes.offer: How well can you handle the Cocktail Shaker? Well, prove your mix and shake skills by making each of these drinks: Creamy Martini, Mabbish Coffee, Spicy Grog, Carrot Margarita, Cloudberry Daiquiri, Gurly Drink, Slow Gin Fizz, Cosma-politan, Flaming Humbaba, Pungent Sunrise, Face Smelter.
cocktailcrafting_make_level3_recipes.completion: That's some fine shaking. Friendly is pleased!

create_giant_icon.title: Loyalty's Rich Reward
create_giant_icon.desc: Collect eleven Emblems of one Giant and iconize them to create a Giant's Icon.
create_giant_icon.offer: Emblems, eh? Don't you just love them? Aren't they just the greatest? But are they the greatest? No. They are not. In the eyes of the Giants, they are merely the first step. It is time for you to progress. To the next step. Beyond the Emblem. And what's greater than an Emblem? Yes! More Emblems! Many Emblems! Choose a Giant, accumulate eleven Emblems for that Giant, and then… well, do what comes naturally. And by that I mean "iconize the Emblems", to make an Icon out of them, not anything weird. Get to it, my little Supplicant!
create_giant_icon.completion: Oh, it's glorious. <split butt_txt="Why, thank you…" /> The adoration and munificent blessings of your Giant are enough, of course. But just in case, here's a little something from me, too.

requirements.name: icons_created
requirements.desc: Make an Icon of a Giant of your choice.

croppery_harvest_all_crops.title: Crops a-Planty
croppery_harvest_all_crops.desc: Harvest at least one each of the 12 Crops in your Garden or in a Community Garden. Important: You can cultivate a Crop Garden in your yard or home street.
croppery_harvest_all_crops.offer: Hay there. Hay there. My attempt at rustic humor. I've noticed you have a knack for growing stuff, and stuff. Harvest at least one of each of the 12 Crops, and there might be a little something extra in it for you, my grubby little dirt pirate.
croppery_harvest_all_crops.completion: Well, lookee who's harvested all 12 Crops. I could just eat you up. <split butt_txt="Yay!" />Actually, come to think of it, I could eat you up. <split butt_txt="Oh." />But I mean it figuratively this time. <split butt_txt="Hooray!" />Here's a little something compensatory for your troubles. Feel free to spend it all in one place.

croppery_harvest_and_sell_at_auction.title: Tater 'n' Mater
croppery_harvest_and_sell_at_auction.desc: Grow 50 Potatoes and 50 Tomatoes, then sell them at an Auction. You will, of course, need your own Crop Garden or a Community Garden for all this growing. You can cultivate a Crop Garden in your yard or home street.
croppery_harvest_and_sell_at_auction.offer: If you want to get by in this world, kid, you have to think big. Not quite that big. I was thinking more like growing-50-Potatoes-and-50-Tomatoes and selling-them-at-auction big. I'm keeping my eye on you, kid. See you after the harvest.
croppery_harvest_and_sell_at_auction.completion: You did it! You sold your crops! How did it feel? <split butt_txt="Capitalism is a seductive mistress."/ > Ooookaaaay. Anyway. Here's a little something extra, not that you really need it now. Don't go blowing this all on practical stuff. Live a little!

croppery_plant_and_harvest.title: A Beltful of Onions
croppery_plant_and_harvest.desc: Plant and Harvest 50 Onions from your Garden or from a Community Garden. Important: You can cultivate a Crop Garden in your yard or home street. You'll need a Watering Can, a Hoe, and some Onion Seeds.
croppery_plant_and_harvest.offer: Hey, kid, I've got an important job for you. Well, I can't name names, but someone pretty high up needs an onion belt. You and everybody else, kid. If you want to help, cultivate yourself a Crop Garden and Plant and Harvest 50 Onions. Can you handle it?
croppery_plant_and_harvest.completion: What's this? A bunch of onions? <split butt_txt="Yup, just like you asked." />Oh. Oh, yeah. Bad news, kid. While you were working, onion belts went out of style. <split butt_txt="Well, dang." /> Fashion is a capricious beast, kid. Don't let it get you down. Here's a little something extra for all your hard work. <split butt_txt="Thanks!" /> And as a little bonus, you can even keep those onions.

crystal_climb.title: Crystal Climb
crystal_climb.desc: Climb fastest to the top of the crystal maze to win. WIN!
crystal_climb.offer: Climb fastest to the top of the crystal maze to win. WIN!

daily_mechanics.title: A Day's Work
daily_mechanics.desc: Do these things in a game day: Collect Imagination from the magic rock in your house; re-deal iMG upgrade cards; hit your daily quoin limit; reflect on an icon (tip: you might visit Home Streets of high level players to find an Icon).
daily_mechanics.offer: Hey, kid. Ever feel when a day ends that there's something you forgot to do? <split butt_txt="All the time." /> No more! I'll teach you a little routine that has been practiced since the dawn of imagination. <split butt_txt="I'm ready!" /> OK! Do these things in one game day, and the motivational reward will be yours. Go! <split butt_txt="What are they?" />Oh - collect imagination from the rock, re-deal upgrade cards, hit your daily quoin limit, and lay your hands on someone else's icon. <split butt_txt="Where do I find an icon?" />Visit the home streets of high level glitches.
daily_mechanics.completion: Productive day, innit? <split butt_txt="I bet I forgot something." /> No worries, there's always the next day. <split butt_txt="You mentioned motivational rewards?" /> Here!

de_embiggenify.title: De-Embiggenify
de_embiggenify.desc: Get small and find a hairball to help out.
de_embiggenify.offer: Hey, kid. I've got a job for you. But it's going to require some shrinkage. You up for it? Don't worry. You'll be re-embiggened later. I knew you had it in you, kid. Go find Mr. Hairball. He'll fill you in on the small print.
de_embiggenify.completion: You found me! You wouldn't believe how many times people mistake me for a common ball of hair. <split butt_txt="Not me. You have a lot of presence for a hairball." />Thanks, buddy.

de_embiggenify_part2.title: De-Embiggenify II
de_embiggenify_part2.desc: Help Mr. Hairball find his shiny object. It must be somewhere in this room.
de_embiggenify_part2.offer: Now here's the thing. There's a small shiny object with no intrinsic value somewhere in this room. I know. I'd get it myself, but I'm kind of lacking in the appendage department, if you know what I mean. Find it and bring it back to me, will you?(And here's a hint: have a look behind the cake!)
de_embiggenify_part2.completion: Thanks, buddy. I knew I could count on you. And just to show that even a hairball can have the heart of a king, I want you to have a little thank-you gift. <split butt_txt="Aw, that's nice." />This emotional bear will come in handy later in the game. Use it on its own, or upgrade it with some optional accessories and start spreading some cheer.

requirements.name: r96
requirements.desc: Collect a Small shiny object with no intrinsic value

dead_head.title: Dead Head
dead_head.desc: Take a picture of yourself … dead, and in Hell (also known as Naraka).
dead_head.offer: I hear Naraka is actually quite lovely this time of year.Yes - and I'm sure you'll love it. You'll have to die first, but you can always come back! While you're there, take a picture to remember it by!
dead_head.completion: Devilishly good, my friend.<split butt_txt="Grateful to be here, actually." />. Told ya so! Sometimes the unknown is more inviting than you'd expect. Here's something for your travels.

distilling_make_and_distribute_hooch.title: One For My Baby - and 23 More for the Road
distilling_make_and_distribute_hooch.desc: Prove your consumate boozehoundery. Use a Still using your expert Distilling skill and a handful of Grain, Corn or Potatoes. Then sell, trade, flog, hawk or otherwise distribute your moonshine.
distilling_make_and_distribute_hooch.offer: Pssssst! Kid! You available? I've heard rumours of impending disaster. I say disaster! I'm not saying where - *cough* Bureaucrats *cough* - but there's been threat of a booze-shortage for a while now. Don't worry, kid. We're prepared. All we need is a small band of plucky moonshiners with the Distilling skill… You don't say! So get yourself a Still, some Grain, Potatoes or Corn, and a quiet, safe place, then brew up - I don't know, 24 Hooches? Then put those jugs back into circulation somehow. Sell 'em, gift 'em, whatever: just get 'em out there. They can take our money, they can take our papers, but they'll never take our booze, right comrade?
distilling_make_and_distribute_hooch.completion: Didn't that feel good? <split butt_txt="I felt cool. And dangerous. But in a good way." /> I can't help it. Even after all this time, the art of Distilling, and, more specifically, the tool used for it, gives me thrills like no other. You know what they say… <split butt_txt="No?" /> I'm "Still-crazy, after all these years". <split butt_txt="Ay…" /> Gettit? Kid? Still? Like the tool, the still? Kid? Wait, where are you going?!? Don't forget your reward!

donate_1000_favor_every_giant_one_day.title: Whole Lotta Love
donate_1000_favor_every_giant_one_day.desc: Donate 1000 favor to each Giant in a single game day.
donate_1000_favor_every_giant_one_day.offer: It's not true to think the Giants never talk, you know. Sure, they may not speak in voices you can hear - frankly, even one of their voices would explode your head into a billion pieces before they got through a word. But they whisper to each other through vibrating threads of imagination. And they know when you've been favoring one of them above others. And they don't like it. How about this: as a show of general loyalty, donate 1000 favor to each and every Giant, in one single day. That'll show'em. You in?
donate_1000_favor_every_giant_one_day.completion: Heavy donating, little Giant-Pleaser. Good job. Did what work? Oh! Well, the Giants aren't saying bad things about you any more. Not sure they ever were, to be honest. It's very easy to mishear vibrations on threads of imagination. They may have been discussing last night's game for all I know. Oh! Um! Hey! You want a reward? Here's a reward!

donate_to_all_shrines.title: Respect for the Beginnings
donate_to_all_shrines.desc: Donate a little something to a shrine for each of the Eleven Giants. You can donate anything, but the more valuable the item(s) you donate, the more favor you earn.
donate_to_all_shrines.offer: I see you've discovered shrine donation … <split butt_txt="Indeed." /> That's good, because donation is an important thing: you'll need to do a lot of it to get ahead.<split butt_txt="I'm willing." />Find a shrine to each of the Eleven Giants and donate something — you'll learn a lot along the way.
donate_to_all_shrines.completion: Very good indeed. Your favor with the Giants will come in handy as you learn more skills. <split butt_txt="Super." />So, don't forget to keep donating. And, if I was you, I'd start inquiring into some of Shrine Powders<split butt_txt="Shrine Powders?" />Yeah, Shrine Powders … ask around. For now, I have a little something for you.

requirements.name: shrine_donated_alph
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Alph

requirements.name: shrine_donated_cosma
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Cosma

requirements.name: shrine_donated_friendly
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Friendly

requirements.name: shrine_donated_grendaline
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Grendaline

requirements.name: shrine_donated_humbaba
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Humbaba

requirements.name: shrine_donated_lem
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Lem

requirements.name: shrine_donated_mab
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Mab

requirements.name: shrine_donated_pot
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Pot

requirements.name: shrine_donated_spriggan
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Spriggan

requirements.name: shrine_donated_ti
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Tii

requirements.name: shrine_donated_zille
requirements.desc: Donate to a shrine to Zille

doody_inspector.title: Doody Inspector
doody_inspector.desc: Find and investigate 5 Piggy Plops. Tip: you can make a Piggy plop by feeding it any Crop products (like potatoes, onions, broccoli, cabbage, corn, etc.)
doody_inspector.offer: Hey, kid! I've got a job for you. But I'll tell you right now: you're going to get your hands dirty. Let me tell you about the gig first. See, something's up with the Piggies. Yeah. And there's only one way to get to the bottom of it. You need to get out there and examine some Piggy Plop. You may have to feed the Piggies to encourage them to do their doody. Don't worry. Not only does Piggy Plop smell like fancy perfume, it also has powerful life-enhancing properties. No. But will you do it anyway?
doody_inspector.completion: That wasn't so bad now, was it, kid? For being a good sport, here's a bunch of currants and stuff. <split butt_txt="Thanks!" />Don't mention it. Now go wash your hands. No offense, but you stink a little.

elementhandling_buy_elemental_pouch.title: Get Elemental!
elementhandling_buy_elemental_pouch.desc: Buy an Elemental Pouch from a Street Spirit who sells Alchemical Goods, or Hardware.
elementhandling_buy_elemental_pouch.offer: Element handling, eh? That's a handy skill. But you are going to need a pouch for that. Go and buy one from a Street Spirit who sells Alchemical Goods or Hardware.
elementhandling_buy_elemental_pouch.completion: Great! Now that you have a pouch, I've filled it up with some elements. But ... you can't do anything with them till you get the Alchemy I skill, so get cracking!Not only that, but you can't make elements yourself without the Refining I skill, which you can get after Mining I.Yeah, yeah ... there's a lot to do. Boo hoo. Get going!

engineering_assemble_machine.title: Machine Shop Pit Stop
engineering_assemble_machine.desc: Fully Assemble and Disassemble any Machine in 2 minutes. (See the Machine Stand encyclopedia page for which machine types exist and what parts they require.)
engineering_assemble_machine.offer: Quick quick quick quick! I need to know, kid, if push came to shove, if we were down to the wire, up against the wall, against the clock, two sheets to the wind, between a rock and a hard place, could you fully assemble and disassemble a Machine in under 2 minutes?!? Well could you at least TRY? See the Machine Stand page for how to get the machine parts, and click on Try it in quest log when you're ready!
engineering_assemble_machine.completion: You passed the test, kid. You passed the mustard. Imagine there was a big pot of mustard just there? Well, you just passed it. <split butt_txt="I think it's 'muster'." /> Don't be ridiculous, that's not even a word. <split butt_txt="Well, actually, it means…" /> Whatever kid. You want your reward, or not?

explore_the_seams.title: Explore The Seams
explore_the_seams.desc: Visit 3 "Seam Streets" located behind key-locked doors around the world. Hint: You will "Finds" the entrance to one of the seam streets on the west side of Andra. (To find the rest, you'll need to ask around, or go exploring!)
explore_the_seams.offer: Ancient lore tells of locations made from the dreamy goo that act as "seams" between the fully-imagined regions of the world.<split butt_txt="Whoa.">You will not find them on any map, and to be worthy of entering, you will need the correct key.<split butt_txt="Sounds exciting!">Go forth, and visit 3 locations that act as "seams" between various regions of the world.
explore_the_seams.completion: Congratulations, worthy glitch. You have visited 3 of the seam streets in the world.<split butt_txt="Hooray!">The giants smile upon you!

eyeballery_identify_object.title: Vision Quest
eyeballery_identify_object.desc: Help a fledgling delivery frog pass his flight exam.
eyeballery_identify_object.offer: So you like looking at things, right? And I hear with your mastery of Eyeballery, you’re pretty good at it too.You know Horntootlery now too? Why, you’re quite the polymath. But I’m not here to talk about your maths. I’m here because someone needs your help.Wait, don’t you want to hear what it is first? No? You’re going to need to take a bit of a trip, so are you absolutely sure you’re ready?
eyeballery_identify_object.completion: That was a good thing you did. You’re a real mensch, or ladysch, or undeclaredsch. Whatever the word for that thing you are is, you’re it.<split butt_txt="Thanks… I think." />You’re welcome, kid. And for your good works, some goodies—

requirements.name: identify_object
requirements.desc: Press 'C' to enter Camera Mode and to identify an object from long way away

ezcooking_1.title: Breezy, EZ Cookin'
ezcooking_1.desc: Get started making delicious, nutritious foods!
ezcooking_1.offer: So, you have an interest in cooking, huh? Well it may surprise you to know that every Master Chef starts by working with a Knife & Board. You ready to learn some cooking skills?
ezcooking_1.completion: Looks like your skills just got a little tastier! Well done, kid.

ezcooking_make_level1_recipes.title: Lay-zee Choppin'
ezcooking_make_level1_recipes.desc: Put a Knife & Board to work and make Flour, a Lazy Salad and a Cheese Plate.
ezcooking_make_level1_recipes.offer: Kid, it appears you have some facility with the Knife & Board now. Great. There are few things easier to make than Flour, Lazy Salad or a Cheese Plate. Make one of each and you'll be on your way to fancier things.
ezcooking_make_level1_recipes.completion: Nice chopping, kid. A bit lazy, but those recipes did not call for more. <split butt_txt="Thanks" /> I set aside a little something for you in case you came through for me here. Enjoy!

ezcooking_make_level2_recipes.title: Sleepytime Feast
ezcooking_make_level2_recipes.desc: Make friends and influence people with this late-night snack, featuring a Juicy Carpaccio, Common Crudites and a Cold Taco.
ezcooking_make_level2_recipes.offer: Snacks kid. They make the world go round. Is there an echo? Snacks. Especially those of the late-night variety. Go make a Sleepytime Feast: a Juicy Carpaccio, some Common Crudites and a Cold Taco. Then you'll see what I'm talking about.
ezcooking_make_level2_recipes.completion: There you have it. A Juicy Carpaccio, Common Crudites and a Cold Taco. A textbook Sleepytime Feast. If I had hands, I would clap. I believe this should more than cover you for your troubles.

find_shiny_intrinsic_object.title: Seeker of the Shiny
find_shiny_intrinsic_object.desc: Help find what Mr. Hairball lost. (Hint: Something smells cheesy.)
find_shiny_intrinsic_object.offer: You know Mr. Hairball? <split butt_txt="The dustbunny?" /> Well, it seems he's lost something yet again ... more like 3 somethings. <split butt_txt="Oh my." /> Search high and low and in every hole to find it.
find_shiny_intrinsic_object.completion: You found all 3! I'll just take them and give it to Mr. Hairball for ya.

requirements.name: r390
requirements.desc: Retrieved 3 Small shiny object with no intrinsic value

firefly_whistle.title: Firefly Whistle
firefly_whistle.desc: Explore the lab and learn what you can about how to charm Fireflies.
firefly_whistle.offer: In the future of one of our pasts, the last days of the Alphite Age, some radical technologists had developed advanced techniques for the charming of fireflies.This knowledge would benefit you tremendously. I can offer to send you back to this past future, but you must find your own way back ...Well, it can't be THAT bad. And, you want to be enchanting those Fireflies, right?
firefly_whistle.completion: Well, well. Swallowed it right down, eh? That's one way to ensure you always have the whistle with you.In any case, from now on, any time you open a Firefly Jar in the presence of Fireflies, your new whistling instinct will kick in. Enjoy!
firefly_whistle.offerNote: npc_firefly.js offers it on collision while the quest is new; the familiar delivers it (features/resource-nodes-feature.js)

fly_paradise.title: Up up and away!
fly_paradise.desc: Use 3 tickets to goto Starlit Night, Cloud Rings, and Abysmal Thrill where gravity has been obsfucated by the Dark Energy of the Rooks.
fly_paradise.offer: Gravity getting you down? Ever wonder how the Dark Energy of the Rooks effect Ur? That's the ticket! Rook attacks often leave a dark residue adrift in the twirling mass of the giants imagination repelling the self-attraction of Ur. But there's some good news. The giants have imagined wonderful lands surrounding this residue where gravity can't get you down! Get upgrade tickets and travel to Starlit Night, Cloud Rings, and Abysmal Thrill. If you've been there before, then it's always better a second or third or fourth time!
fly_paradise.completion: Great work, a ticket to fly can really bring you up when you're feeling down.  Believe it or not you were walking on air! <split butt_txt="Umm I guess I never thought I could feel so free? .. I don't know why I said that!  " /> Here's something to give your arms a little lift.

focusedmeditation_get_mood_or_energy.title: Focus Pocus
focusedmeditation_get_mood_or_energy.desc: Use a Focusing Orb to tame your swirly thoughts and Focus your meditation to gain either 24 energy points or 24 mood points in one try.
focusedmeditation_get_mood_or_energy.offer: How are you digging that Focusing Orb, kid? Really de-swirls the ol' noodle, it does. And you're ready to take the de-swirling to the next level. Try using the Orb again, this time Focusing your meditation on either your mood or your energy, and get 24 points in one or the other. You can do anything, chum. The only thing stopping you is you. Yeah. Ready?
focusedmeditation_get_mood_or_energy.completion: That was some sweet Focused Meditating. You were really in the zone. <split butt_txt="I like the zone." />The zone is good. You know what else is good? This little reward I'm giving you. Just because I can.

requirements.name: meditation_24_mood_energy
requirements.desc: Focus your meditation to gain 24 mood or energy

fruitchanging_transform_fruit.title: Yes, You Have No Bananas
fruitchanging_transform_fruit.desc: Use a Fruit-Changing Machine to convert 45 common Cherries into 5 Oranges, 5 Apples and 5 Strawberries.
fruitchanging_transform_fruit.offer: So you want to be a Fruit Changer, kid. You ready to get your hands juicy? To get started, you're going to need a Fruit-Changing Machine. And some basic Cherries, let's say 45 of 'em. Use those Cherries to make 5 Oranges, 5 Apples and 5 Strawberries. Ready?
fruitchanging_transform_fruit.completion: I see a couple of bruises. The Fruit-Changing Machine demands a light hand, kid. <split butt_txt="Sorry." />But other than that, everything looks ripe. I wouldn't put it on a hat or anything, but it'll do.

fuelmaking_refuel_robot.title: We're Off to See the Lizard
fuelmaking_refuel_robot.desc: Contribute some strictly off-the-record Fuelmaking support to a shady bureaucrat: make a Fuel cell and use it to refuel a Maintenance Bot in any Subway Station.
fuelmaking_refuel_robot.offer: psst, kid. hey. hey, kid. psst. hey. fuelmaking. A friend of mine wants to ask you for a Fuelmaking favour. He told me to ask you on ‘the down low,’ only I don’t know what that is. I think that means I’m supposed to be crouching, but I don’t have any legs, so I’m trying a sort of verbal crouch. It’s harder than it sounds.I don’t exaggerate, kid. Anyway, this friend—or more of an acquaintance, really, or an acquaintance of an acquaintance—has asked to meet in an undisclosed location, for maximum secrecy. “Come alone,” he said.See, I don’t understand what that means either. Does it mean you’re in?
fuelmaking_refuel_robot.completion: Good work, kid!<split butt_txt="Thanks." />And now there’s a bureaucrat out there who owes you a favour. Might come in handy someday, you know. Speaking of handy, the Bureaucracy sent you a little something for helping out.

gardening_harvest_all_trees_in_time_peri.title: One, Two, Tree, Four, Six, Eight
gardening_harvest_all_trees_in_time_peri.desc: Harvest each of the eight different kinds of Trees, all in one game day.
gardening_harvest_all_trees_in_time_peri.offer: Hey, kid. Do you know how many different kinds of Trees there are in the world? And? Eight. There are eight kinds of Trees. Tell you what. Just to help you refresh your memory, I'm going to propose that you harvest each kind at least once within one game day. Pretty easy, right? Well, apart from maybe Wood Trees, they're a rare breed. But then, if you had one in your back yard, or knew someone who did… Not so hard, right? Funny, that's what the wood tree said. Right. Go, kid! And if you do it, I've got something special for you, right here in my invisible left pocket.
gardening_harvest_all_trees_in_time_peri.completion: Good work, bub. Now, quick! Tell me the names of all eight Trees that you harvested. In order! <split butt_txt="Oh! Um! Uh!" /> Just messing with you. Here's a little present, just for being such a sport.

gardening_harvest_last_egg_plant.title: Last Egg Standing
gardening_harvest_last_egg_plant.desc: Do everyone a favor. Harvest the last Egg from an Egg Plant. That way nobody else feels awkward taking the last one.
gardening_harvest_last_egg_plant.offer: You know what bugs me? Well, yes, but that's not what I'm talking about. I'm talking about how nobody wants to be the bad guy and take the last Egg from an Egg Plant. I guess it's better for it to just rot there? Whoa there. You're going all Objectivist on me, kid. There may be a reward in this little endeavor. Don't take it as an endorsement of your crazy ideas.
gardening_harvest_last_egg_plant.completion: I knew I could count on you to clean out the last egg from an Egg Plant. I can't tell if you're being serious, or if you're being funny, so I'm just going to give you this bonus and retreat into watchful silence.

gardening_harvest_trees.title: Bring In The Sheaves
gardening_harvest_trees.desc: Harvest a ripe Fruit Tree, Bubble Tree, and Spice Plant. You won't need special tools to do this, but you may need to make space in your inventory.
gardening_harvest_trees.offer: Take Trees, for instance, kid. Oh. Wait a sec... did I start in the middle of my thought again? Let's start again. How about I keep this simple? Get out there and harvest a ripe Fruit Tree, Bubble Tree and Spice Plant. That's all you need, kiddo. But you'll also have to make sure you've got space to carry your harvest. Got that?
gardening_harvest_trees.completion: That's a pretty fine bunch of harvests you've harvested. What are you going to do with all those Cherries and Bubbles and Allspices? If I were in your foot-mittens, I'd consider getting a Fruit Changing Machine, a Bubble Tuner and a Spice Mill. Here's a little gift to help you out.

gardening_max_harvest_from_all_trees.title: Super Secret Happy Bonus Tree Harvest
gardening_max_harvest_from_all_trees.desc: Use your arboreal mojo to get the maximum harvest from seven kinds of Trees (requires Tree Hugger upgrade)
gardening_max_harvest_from_all_trees.offer: Now that you've hit the zenith of Arborology mastery, I've got a little secret for you, chum. Every time you Harvest a Tree, you've got a shot at a pretty big haul. And if you get a maximum harvest from seven kinds of Trees, you'll get something extra. That's not for me to say. Those trees are touchy about giving away their secrets. In fact, I've probably said too much. Let's forget this conversation ever happened.
gardening_max_harvest_from_all_trees.completion: Just like I said it would happen. The trees love you. You're knee deep in Spices and Bubbles and whatnot. And obviously now you need to use a Spice Mill and a Bubble Tuner and such to process them all. Get to it. Those Spices aren't going to mill themselves.

requirements.name: harvest_bonus_trant_spice
requirements.desc: Get a Spice Plant harvest bonus

requirements.name: harvest_bonus_trant_gas
requirements.desc: Get a Gas Plant harvest bonus

requirements.name: harvest_bonus_trant_fruit
requirements.desc: Get a Fruit Tree harvest bonus

requirements.name: harvest_bonus_trant_egg
requirements.desc: Get an Egg Plant harvest bonus

requirements.name: harvest_bonus_trant_bubble
requirements.desc: Get a Bubble Tree harvest bonus

requirements.name: harvest_bonus_trant_bean
requirements.desc: Get a Bean Tree harvest bonus

requirements.name: harvest_max_wood_tree
requirements.desc: Get the maximum harvest from a Wood Tree

gardening_plant_5_seed_types.title: Mendel's Apprentice
gardening_plant_5_seed_types.desc: Plant 5 different types of vegetable seeds in your crop garden. You can buy vegetable seeds from Gardening Goods Street Spirits or Gardening Tools Vendors.
gardening_plant_5_seed_types.offer: They say one is closest to Mab's heart in a garden. Of course! And there's nothing Mab likes more than to see Glitchen planting seeds and encouraging trant seedlings to grow. Indeed. She's always hopeful that something new and unexpected might pop up out of the soil. Something about G-know-types and Femo-types. Kind of. Why not see what sprouts by planting five different types of vegetable crops on your Home Street? You'll want to imagine a crop garden first, then beg, buy, or borrow some vegetable seeds (like broccoli, spinach, or parsnips). Gardening Tools Vendors or Gardening Goods Street Spirits are a good place to start.
gardening_plant_5_seed_types.completion: Look at you grow! That's some mighty fine croppery, there {pc_label}!  Who knows what tranty traits your mutant crop garden might produce?  Ever heard of a triffid?  Well...never mind.  Here are some resources to help you continue your (possibly diabolical) research.

requirements.name: Plant 5 seeds
requirements.desc: Plant 5 vegetable seeds in your crop garden

gardening_plant_beans_make_sure_become_t.title: Bean There, Done That
gardening_plant_beans_make_sure_become_t.desc: Plant three Seasoned Beans in three Patches and lovingly nurture them through that trying Seedling phase. (Important: You can do this one bean at a time, not all at once.)
gardening_plant_beans_make_sure_become_t.offer: So, by now you've gotten the hang of this Arborology business, wouldn't you say? Oh, sure, it's easy when you do it all random-like, running helter skelter all over Groddle Forest and such. So I've got a challenge for you, my chartreuse-thumbed chum. I want you to plant three separate Seasoned Beans, and single-handedly raise them till they graduate from the Seedling stage. You know it. But you don't have to grow them all at once. One at a time is fine. Okay?
gardening_plant_beans_make_sure_become_t.completion: You've given those three Seedlings a promising start, young friend. I find this all strangely moving. I'm feeling a little verklempt up here. Take this little reward, then scram so I can collect myself.

gasmogrification_transform_gasses.title: Get the Vapours
gasmogrification_transform_gasses.desc: Turn General Vapour into exciting gases! Use a Gassifier to make 3 Heavy Gas, 3 Helium and 3 Crying Gas.
gasmogrification_transform_gasses.offer: Gassy? Then do you want to be? That's the spirit. Get yourself a Gassifier and use it to convert some General Vapour into Heavy Gas, Helium and Crying Gas. Three of each it is, my earnest young snapperwhipper. Ready?
gasmogrification_transform_gasses.completion: Let me count... 1... 2... 3. Yup, you gassified 3 Heavy Gas, 3 Helium and 3 Crying Gas. Nicely done. <split butt_txt="It's all in the wrist." /> Now that you've broken in your Gassifier, there's a rich and satisfying world of other gases for you to explore. <split butt_txt="I can't wait!" /> Before you go, here's a little bonus reward prize thingummy.

get_first_tool.title: Tooling Around
get_first_tool.desc: You've got the skills; now get the tools.
get_first_tool.offer: You've got the skills; now get the tools.

glitchmas2010.title: A Holiday Thing
glitchmas2010.desc: All you have to do is type "yay" into local chat and you will get a gift.
glitchmas2010.offer: It's a special time of year. A time that makes me feel a little funny. And when I feel funny, I like to give presents.<split butt_txt="OK …">All you have to do is type "yay" into the local chat and I will give you a gift.
glitchmas2010.completion: Yay. Yay! YAY! YAY!!! You did it. I put a little present into your pack. Unwrap it and see what you think!

good_neighbor.title: Like a Good Neighbor
good_neighbor.desc: Tend to 11 resources on your neighbors' home streets.
good_neighbor.offer: There's something to be said for solitude, but you're not going to get very far very quickly on your own.<split butt_txt="I was afraid of that" />Don't worry, I promise it's painless. Though there is some work involved.<split butt_txt="This keeps getting better." />All you gotta do is add some neighbors to that signpost over there, visit their home streets, and tend 11 of their resources.
good_neighbor.completion: Well, aren't you a friendly citizen of Ur? A good deed is its own reward, so...<split butt_txt="[awkward silence]" />Oh, fine, here's a little something!

grab_em_good.title: Grab 'Em Good
grab_em_good.desc: Collect all the quoins. Whoever gets the most wins!
grab_em_good.offer: Collect all the quoins. Whoever gets the most wins!

greedy_street_spirit.title: The Greedy Street Spirit
greedy_street_spirit.desc: Visit storyland and read a bedtime story, once told all around Ur, to help a little piglet sleep.
greedy_street_spirit.offer: You know after a nice full meal, you feel all sleepy and slumberful?  <split butt_txt="Oh yeeaaah, good times." /> Well, I know of this one piglet that no matter how much he ate, just couldn't feel sleepy. <split butt_txt="Sounds awful." /> It was bad, this unsleepiness. But there was one thing which finally helped: a favorite bedtime story told all 'round Ur since the dawn of the Third Era. Would you like to go to storyland and read it?
greedy_street_spirit.completion: Wasn't that sweet? Here's a cuddly Emotional Bear to remind you of this bedtime story.

greedy_street_spirit_reminisce.title: Greedy Street Spirit Story
greedy_street_spirit_reminisce.desc: Visit storyland and read a bedtime story, once told all around Ur, to help a little piglet sleep.
greedy_street_spirit_reminisce.offer: Are you ready to reminisce Greedy Street Spirit Story?
greedy_street_spirit_reminisce.completion: Wasn't that sweet? Now that naptime is over, here's some breakfast.

grilling_make_level1_recipes.title: The Grill of Victory
grilling_make_level1_recipes.desc: Fire up a patented, accept-no-substitutes Famous Pugilist Grill and make a Simple BBQ and 3 Grilled Cheese.
grilling_make_level1_recipes.offer: You know, kid, I've never met a person who doesn't like a good Grilled Cheese. So how's about you get yourself a Famous Pugilist Grill, fire it up, and grill up a Grilled Cheese. Better yet, make that three. And while you're at it, cook up a Simple BBQ. All good people like BBQ, kid. You in?
grilling_make_level1_recipes.completion: Well, kid. If the last great Famous Pugilist himself were here right now, he'd say... <split butt_txt="What? What would he say?" /> Um "mumble-mumble, humna-humna-humna". <split butt_txt="And that would mean?…" /> Hecked if I know, kid. He lost his last tooth approximately the same time as his last braincell. But I bet he still liked Grilled Cheese.

grilling_make_level2_recipes.title: Lemburgers for Lem
grilling_make_level2_recipes.desc: Get your greasy mitts on, put your Famous Pugilist Grill to work, and make 3 deliciously junksome Lemburgers to donate to Lem. (Hint: You can find Shrines to Lem all over the place - try checking the map for your nearest designated donation hole)
grilling_make_level2_recipes.offer: Hey Griddlepants, how's it going with that Famous Pugilist Grill of yours? It's like cooking with the harnessed power of the sun, right? You're going to use it to make Lem happy. Yes. You know, the Giant? One of the all-powerful imaginators without whom you would never have… Ringing any bells? *sigh*. Well, as you might imagine, he loves himself a Lemburger or three every now and again. That's the spirit. So sizzle yo' shizzle, and when they're all ready, you can donate them to the Shrine to Lem.
grilling_make_level2_recipes.completion: Ah. I love the smell of Lemburgers in the morning. You clearly know your way around a Famous Pugilist Grill. <split butt_txt="Thanks!" />Consider this little reward an investment in your promising career in the meat-cooking industry.

grub_giver.title: Grub Giver
grub_giver.desc: In one game day, make each recipe that a Awesome Pot can make, and give each item away to a different person.
grub_giver.offer: Do you like pot?  <split butt_txt="Uhhh..." /> Oh wait, I mean do you like your Awesome Pot?  <split butt_txt="It's pretty awesome." />  Wouldn't it feel great to share your
grub_giver.completion: Paying it forward is it's own reward... <split butt_txt="Ok..." /> O, and here's a little something for your trouble.... Pay it forward.

requirements.name: r422
requirements.desc: Make a Hi-Sucrose Corn Syrup Square

hell_hole.title: It's Better in a Hell Hole
hell_hole.desc: Continue exploring Naraka by jumping into the hole on the first level of Hell.
hell_hole.offer: Continue exploring Naraka by jumping into the hole on the first level of Hell.
hell_hole.completion: I was hoping for more of a swan dive, but I guess that'll have to do.

hell_quest.title: Beelzebooze
hell_quest.desc: Enter the Hell Bar in Panka Surazu, Naraka, exchange your Diabolical Drink Ticket for Wine of the Dead and drink to your good hellth… er, "health."
hell_quest.offer: I know it looks gloomy down here, but it ain't so bad; great atmosphere, no cover charge and even a free drink ticket. <split butt_txt="Thanks... I think?" />Take this drink ticket to the Hell Bar at the far end of Naraka and exchange it for a bottle of Wine of the Dead. I have a feeling you’ll enjoy its revitalizing qualities.
hell_quest.completion: How do you feel now, kid? Like a great weight has been lifted off your shoulders?<split butt_txt="More or less." />Great! Now go explore Naraka. Have fun. Don't do anything I wouldn't do. Oh, and take these extras for your excellent work.

help_juju_bandits.title: Carry That Weight
help_juju_bandits.desc: Solve all the clues to help the Juju Bandits recover their priceless family heirloom—the Ancestral Paperweight.
help_juju_bandits.offer:
{pc_label}! You're going to help us whether you like it or not!
<split butt_txt="Wait, what?" />Who’s tough and translucent and asking for your help? That’s right, {pc_label}, it’s the infamous Juju Bandits!<split butt_txt="Are you trying to ask for my help?" />Uh… yeah. Sorry, I’m really only good at threatening people.<split butt_txt="A little politeness wouldn't hurt." />Politeness? Ha, the Juju Bandits are the meanest gang around, you’ll be quaking in your boots with helpfulness, if you know what’s… no, that doesn’t sound right either. Hold on. I can do this.<split butt_txt="OK, I'll help if we can just stop talking about this." />Ha! I knew you’d see it our way, {pc_label}. Now come on, the boss wants to see you.
help_juju_bandits.offerNote: npc_juju_bandit offers it: a Dust Trap in Baqala, Zhambu, Xalanga or Choru brings one half the time while the quest is new (dust_trap.js, juju_bandit_curse)

help_juju_bandits_2.title: Carry That Weight II
help_juju_bandits_2.desc: Return the Ancestral Paperweight to the Secret Juju Bandit Hideout
help_juju_bandits_2.offer: You found the Ancestral Paperweight!<split butt_txt="Yay!" />You'll need to return that to the Juju Bandits' Hideout. Ready?
help_juju_bandits_2.completion: Ah, the Paperweight!<split butt_txt="Will you stop stealing my stuff now?" />I’ll reward you for your efforts, but like I said, the moment you leave, your paper is in jeopardy.<split butt_txt="What’s with all the paper, anyway?" />It’s something to do, isn’t it? The Rook makes work for idle hands, as my husband used to say. Anyway, Smelly, here’s your reward. Nice doing business with you.

help_mine.title: I Me Mine
help_mine.desc: Help three people to mine rocks.
help_mine.offer: Jars. <split butt_txt="I’m sorry. What?" />Do you ever have trouble opening stuck jars? <split butt_txt="Sometimes, if they’re real stuck.">Well, you know how sometimes you just can’t get a jar open no matter how long you work at it, but if you pass it to a friend, they get it open right away? <split butt_txt="It’s because I already loosened it." /> Kid, mining is like a stuck jar. <split butt_txt="Huh?" /> Mining, as in with rocks. Sometimes mining is tough on your own, but if you have a friend helping you, it gets way easier… and more fun, like squash. <split butt_txt="I don’t think squash comes in jars." /> No, I mean with the rackets and—you know what?
