Just forget the analogies for a minute. Find someone who’s working on a rock and help them mine by mining at the same time. Do it three times. Can you manage that? I promise you’ll find selflessness deeply fulfilling on a spiritual level.
help_mine.completion: Nice work, kid. <split butt_txt="Thanks!" />Do you feel more helpful? Do you feel like a more fulfilled and productive member of society? <split butt_txt="I feel kinda sleepy." /> Well, mining is a lot of work. Why don’t you take a quick break?

herbalism_get_super_harvest.title: Herbal Hat-Trickery
herbalism_get_super_harvest.desc: Get a 'super harvest' of Herb flowers, three times.
herbalism_get_super_harvest.offer: You know what's better than a single herbal harvest, my little underground gardener? A double harvest. And the only thing better than a double harvest, of course, is… My Giant, you're good. Yes! Triple! A herbal SUPER-HARVEST! A super harvest of herbs from single seed is a marvel to behold. Of course, while it's marvellous to behold it once, it's even more impressive if you behold it twice. And the only thing better than that… Ok, ok. Get a triple harvest of herbs three times. Maybe THEN you'll understand my excitement.
herbalism_get_super_harvest.completion: Super-triple-herbal harvest! Three times the herbs! Not once, not twice but three times! Now tell me that wasn't a marvel unlike anything you've ever seen before! <split butt_txt="It was certainly something." /> That's right, kid! Something! And here's something else, just for being you.

requirements.name: super_harvest_herb
requirements.desc: Get 3 triple harvests of herb flowers

herbalism_harvest_shuck_and_plant_herbs.title: Shucks To Be You
herbalism_harvest_shuck_and_plant_herbs.desc: Shuck herbs until you have 6 seeds. Then plant the seeds, and harvest the herbs.
herbalism_harvest_shuck_and_plant_herbs.offer: The circle of all life can be traced to one simple, physical act, little Herbalist. Shucking. You like to shuck, kid? Shucking! No new Herbs exist without someone having shucked the generation before them. A good vigorous shuck provides the seeds for Herbal life as we know it to continue. Try it: take these Herbs, and shuck them to release 6 Seeds, then plant those seeds to grow new Herbs, and harvest them. You in?
herbalism_harvest_shuck_and_plant_herbs.completion: Beautiful isn't it? <split butt_txt="Shucking?" /> The act of shucking is beautiful, of course, but the whole circle of life thing: each generation giving up Seeds for the next, and… oh. You're just waiting for your reward, aren't you? <split butt_txt="Yes." /> Go on, then, you little shucker. Take these tiny tokens, and begone…

requirements.name: seeds_extracted
requirements.desc: Shuck herbs until you have 6 seeds

herbalism_plant_seeds_in_someones_garden.title: The Philantherbist
herbalism_plant_seeds_in_someones_garden.desc: Surprise a friend by planting three Herb Seeds in a garden on their Home Street or back yard, or a stranger by planting three Herb Seeds in a Community Herb Garden. Spread the love, herbally speaking.
herbalism_plant_seeds_in_someones_garden.offer: Do you know what's interesting about generosity, my Advanced Herbologist friend? <split butt_txt="It sounds like it begins with a J?" /> No. Well, yes. But more than that, generosity has been proven to improve the experience of all Herbs. <split butt_txt="Really?" /> Mhm. Try planting some Seeds – not many: three, say? – in a friend's Herb Garden for a surprise or planting some Seeds in a Community Garden for a stranger to find. Any Herb afterward will be just a little more… well, you in?
herbalism_plant_seeds_in_someones_garden.completion: So? You planted Herbs for others? <split butt_txt="So. Herbs should be better now?" /> I said that? That doesn't sound right. Ah! Herbal experiences improve with Tinctures. That's what I meant. What you did, on the other hand? Pure philanthropy. You know what's interesting about philanthropy? <split butt_txt="It sounds like it begins with an F?…" /> Um. Have a reward, kid.

requirements.name: herb_seeds_planted_for_others
requirements.desc: Plant 3 herb seeds in a garden that's not yours

herdkeeping_capture_piggies.title: Hogtie Some Hoggies
herdkeeping_capture_piggies.desc: Capture three wily Piggies in the wild (NB: Your garden's not very wild, Sly…). Want a tip? Nothing tempts Piggies like Pig Bait.
herdkeeping_capture_piggies.offer: Hey, kid. How do you feel about doing some good old-fashioned hogtying? Aw. You're cute. No, don't worry about it. Piggies love being tied up. So get out there, find three Piggies, roaming in the wild - not your own garden, mind, the wildy-wild - and bring'em back bound and gagged, OK? Just for effect. You in?
herdkeeping_capture_piggies.completion: Soooeeey. Nice work, kid. I like what you did with the butterfly knot. You sure you haven't done this before?

high_jump.title: The High Jumper
high_jump.desc: Get to the top of tree in your Magic Rock's memory-place, Activating whatever you need along the way.
high_jump.offer: You know that poem in the beginning of The Great Gatsby?I remember really liking it, but I can't remember how it goes. Help me?OK then. Let me transport you to my special memory place and we'll give it a go ...
high_jump.completion:
Ah, yes - I remember! You did it!Yes, the poem goes like this ...Then wear the gold hat, if that will move her;
     if you can bounce high, bounce for her too,
Till she cry "Lover, gold-hatted, high-bouncing lover,
     I must have you!"I feel like I should give you a Gold Hat now ... but the Giants haven't made a mind-picture of it yet.Oh well. Whatever. Great poem, great poem. Here's a lil' something more.

requirements.name: top_of_tree
requirements.desc: Get to the top of the tree

hogtie_piggy.title: The Great Hog Haul
hogtie_piggy.desc: Hogtie three Piggies and put them in the Pig Pen!
hogtie_piggy.offer: The Piggies got loose from their pen!<split butt_txt="Oh noes.">So, let's use that as an arbitrary excuse to have a race.<split butt_txt="Seems appropriate.">Be the first to hogtie 3 Piggies and return them to their pen to win!
hogtie_piggy.completion: Dem Piggies got hogtied up good! Nice work.

homelier_sweet_home.title: Homelier Sweet Home
homelier_sweet_home.desc: Once you have the penpersonship skill, visit the home streets (or house) of every one of your friends and leave them a house-warming gift and a note to accompany it.
homelier_sweet_home.offer: Isn't it nice to receive house-warming gifts? Now that you're a skilled penperson, visit the homes of each of your friends and leave them a gift with a friendly note attached. I guarantee it'll make you feel all warm inside.
homelier_sweet_home.completion: Congrats! You've spread warmth to all of your friends and made their homes a little homelier. I bet you feel some of that warmth too.

intermediateadmixing_make_more_powders.title: Master the Beaker
intermediateadmixing_make_more_powders.desc: Make a jar of Fairly Hallowed Shrine Powder and the Powder of Mild Fecundity. Make these, and more recipes will be yours.
intermediateadmixing_make_more_powders.offer: You’re learning to love the Beaker, kid. Now learn to let the beaker love you. Harder. Make yourself a jar of Fairly Hallowed Shrine Powder and some Powder of Mild Fecundity. You have the recipes already: all you need are the ingredients. All in time, little one. Now beak away, my sorcerer. Beak like you’ve never beaked before.
intermediateadmixing_make_more_powders.completion: You’ve beaked, I can tell. You’re radiant and kind of glowy. But don’t worry, that’s a known side effect, it wears off. Still, try donating to a Shrine after sprinkling it with a Shrine Powder - the effect will be powerful, if sadly temporary. And be sure to use your Powder of Fecundity on a street full of Animals. They’ll fecund all over the place for you. Sure I do. Now fecund and leave me be, kid.

requirements.name: r117
requirements.desc: Make a Fairly Hallowed Shrine Powder

requirements.name: r118
requirements.desc: Make a Powder of Mild Fecundity

intermediateadmixing_make_powder.title: Begin with The Beaker
intermediateadmixing_make_powder.desc: Make a jar of Fertilidust Lite powder. For this, you will need 15 Humbabol and 10 Potoxin compounds. And a Beaker. Obviously.
intermediateadmixing_make_powder.offer: Delving into the dark arts of admixing, eh? Well, dark in the sense of ‘pleasant and above board, if a tiny bit mysterious’. Try making some Fertilidust Lite powder. Your Beaker knows the recipe already: all you need are the ingredients.
intermediateadmixing_make_powder.completion: And they shall call you 'All-Powerful Font of Fertilidust!' They shall call you 'Beako! Beako!' No. But they should. Still, you should try sprinkling some of your shiny new Fertilidust Lite powder near a Tree, and watch it fizzle with health, grow up quicker, and start speaking Humbabanese. No. But the other two things? Totally.

jason_test_quest.title: TEST: Make me two sammichs! NOW!
jason_test_quest.desc: The taskmaster has asked you to make him 2 sammiches.
jason_test_quest.offer: I'm really hungry. I have low blood sugar. Please make me two sammiches before I faint.
jason_test_quest.completion: Oh thank you so much. I feel better already. Enjoy your reward.

jellisachands_donate_jellisacs.title: A Slatheration of Jellisacs
jellisachands_donate_jellisacs.desc: Gather Jellisacs until you get a 'super harvest', then take them to a Shrine to Grendaline and slather the Shrine in Jellisacs.
jellisachands_donate_jellisacs.offer: Fine pair of Jellisac Hands you've got there, old chap. You're welcome. And well-equipped to do me a kindness. Well, not me, per se: Grendaline. You heard right, kid. Grendaline, all reverence to her watery glory, has a bit of a craving for Jellisacs. Don't ask why: I think she might gargle with them or something. All I know is, it would be peachy if you could gather Jellisacs until you get a 'super harvest', then take them to a Shrine to Grendaline - any Shrine to Grendaline, and slather the shrine in them. Yup, slather. Not donate: slather. You'll see when you get there.
jellisachands_donate_jellisacs.completion: Grendaline thanks you. <split butt_txt="Really?" /> Well, she would if she didn't have a throat full of Jellisac. <split butt_txt="But… but I slathered them on the shrine…" /> Don't ask how the science works, kid, somehow they soak into the shrine and end up in the mind of Grendaline's mouth. Seriously, it's very complicated. You know what's not so complicated? Rewards. You gots some. Enjoy.

requirements.name: jellisacs_slathered
requirements.desc: Slather Jellisacs on a Shrine to Grendaline

job_tower_ph4.completion:
Create a new street: {job_location}

Hey buddy, that was a hard one, but with your help we were able to create that new street! You did {job_participation}% of the work, nice.Here's some stuff to thank you. Want to check out your handiwork? This teleport to {job_location} is on me.

join_club.title: Join the Club
join_club.offer: Welcome home {pc_label}.  While you were away, you received an intriguing invitation. It appears you've been invited to join the club. <split butt_txt="Club? Which club?" /> I must admit, I'm not entirely sure. But, rumor has it that once inside the clubhouse, you gain access to a perfectly picturesque location. Interested?
join_club.completion: It looks like you were accepted to the club! Myself, I don't want to belong to any club that will accept people like me as a member. But, as they say … "Membership has its rewards!"

join_club_reminisce.title: Join the Club

join_club_reminisce.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.

jump_in_hole.desc: Go find The Great Hole to Ix and ... jump in!
jump_in_hole.offer: Go find The Great Hole to Ix and ... jump in!
jump_in_hole.completion: Jolly good! Someone told you to jump in a hole, and you did! Now that's ... <split butt_txt="Courage?" />No, no ... it's, um ...<split butt_txt="Gumption?" />Yeah, not that either. It's more like ... <split butt_txt="Blind Obedience?" />Yes. Yes. And it's nothing to be ashamed of. Here's your reward.

offerTriggers.why: exploration quest; no gate in source

kindly_randomness.title: A Kindly Act of Randomness
kindly_randomness.desc: Give at least one item to five players who are still at Level 3, 4 or 5. (Hint: Click on a player and then "Info" to find out their level).
kindly_randomness.offer: Looking for that warm, fuzzy feeling?No, not that one. The other one.It is a good thing to help those less experienced than yourself. Find five players at Level 3, 4 or 5 and give them a lil' something.Anything you have on you. Use your imagination, kid — it's a present!
kindly_randomness.completion: You are randomly kind and kindly random. Keep that generosity in your heart, kid: it suits you.

last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth.title: The Last Pilgrimage of Esquibeth
last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth.desc: Contemplate the heroic actions of Esquibeth on her last pilgrimage.
last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth.offer: Kid, you now know a little something about the Giants. You’ve matured. I think you are ready to contribute to a Feat.<split butt_txt="I think I am." />But first, you need to spend some time contemplating the Ancient Heroes. Otherwise your contribution to the re-creation of their sacred accomplishments will always … ring false. Are you ready?
last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth.offerNote: shrine_donation event trigger; offered after donate_to_all_shrines

last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth_reminisce.title: The Last Pilgrimage of Esquibeth
last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth_reminisce.desc: Retrace the heroic actions of Esquibeth on her last pilgrimage.
last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth_reminisce.offer: Would you like to reminisce The Last Pilgrimage of Esquibeth?
last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth_reminisce.completion: What a long, strange trip it's been.
last_pilgrimage_of_esquibeth_reminisce.offerNote: canOffer: a game day (4 hours) after part 1 and after the last repeat or fail; offered by the Conch Reminisce verb

lava_leap.title: Lava Leap
lava_leap.desc: Be the first to get to the other side!
lava_leap.offer: Be the first to get to the other side!

le_miserable.title: Le Misérable
le_miserable.desc: Visit the Fireflex 3000 Lab once more.
le_miserable.offer: Do you remember the future of one of our pasts? Or was it the past of one of our futures? <split butt_txt="I'm not entirely sure." /> Either way, that Fireflex 3000 Lab had more secrets to reveal than you've uncovered so far. You should explore it a little more.<split butt_txt="OK" /> I can't be sure which part you'll end up in, but it's worth a look. Want to go now?
le_miserable.completion: Oh, little Glitch. What are you doing down here? <split butt_txt="Not really sure …" />
le_miserable.offerNote: a day after Firefly Whistle (source: ten days); canOffer: an hour after a fail

le_miserable_part_2.title: Le Misérable II
le_miserable_part_2.desc: Turn on the machine for the maintenance bot.
le_miserable_part_2.offer: This part of the Lab was perhaps a bad choice. As you can see, there is No Exit. <split butt_txt="Shoot" /> I myself have been stuck here for … one million seven hundred and thirty nine thousand eight hundred and fifty one years :( :( :(  <split butt_txt="Wow" /> But you're shrinkable (lucky!). If you can fit yourself through that crawl space you might be able to get out on the other side.<split butt_txt="OK" />
le_miserable_part_2.completion: Well, you did it. Bully for you. And … sucks to be me. As usual. <split butt_txt=":\" /> No sense sticking around — I'm used to it here. You should keep going. <split butt_txt="OK" /> There's another one of those machines on the other side of the crawl space. It should make you big again. Bye … <split butt_txt="Bye" />

le_miserable_reminisce.title: Le Misérable
le_miserable_reminisce.desc: Turn on the machine in the Fireflex 3000 Lab
le_miserable_reminisce.offerNote: canOffer: an hour after part 2 and after the last repeat

learn_first_skill.title: Start Learning Your First Skill
learn_first_skill.desc: Choose a skill to start with. Click on your Magic Rock and press the button to start learning. (The skill picker will open in a new window.)
learn_first_skill.offer: Choose a skill to start with. Click on your Magic Rock and press the button to start learning. (The skill picker will open in a new window.)
learn_first_skill.completion: This is now in the getCompletion function.

leave_gentle_island.title: On to the Big Time
leave_gentle_island.desc: Find your way off Gentle Island and into the real world.
leave_gentle_island.offer: Kid, you are about ready to see what the world has to offer: plumb the depths of Ilmenskie Caverns, ascend the heights of Rasana and fly through the trees of Roobrik ... there's a lot to explore!<split butt_txt="Sounds like it" />The way off Gentle Island is pretty easy to find. Find it. Take it. Do it!!
leave_gentle_island.completion: You made it kid! Congrats!<split butt_txt="Thanks!" />Take it easy, just explore and ask for help when you need it. You'll be fine.<split butt_txt="I will" />Oh, and here's a little something to help you out …

letter_block_1.title: Child's Play
letter_block_1.desc: Get small and find Mr. Block. He's got a job for you.
letter_block_1.offer: Hey, kid. How do you feel about getting small? <split butt_txt="How small?" /> I won't lie to you. Pretty small. You'll be helping out a buddy of mine. We'll shrink you down to visit him, but don't worry. We'll get you out when you're done.
letter_block_1.completion: Lovely, lovely. That will do quite nicely. Now, wasn't that fun? <split butt_txt="It was OK."> Goodbye now. I must get back to my collection, but accept this as a token of my gratitude.

requirements.name: correct_letter_item
requirements.desc: Give Mr. Block an appropriately named item.

letter_block_2.title: Four Letter Words
letter_block_2.desc: Get small and help Mr. Block spell some four-letter words. Not the naughty kind.
letter_block_2.offer: Hey, kid. You seem pretty bright. I've got a friend who, frankly, is kind of a blockhead. Want to lend him some brain power? <split butt_txt="Sure!" /> We're going to have to shrink you down to meet him. We'll re-embiggen you when you're done, OK?
letter_block_2.completion: He's going to be staring at those blocks for days. <split butt_txt="Yeah. Probably." /> It was big of you to help him, even if he's a bit of a square.<split butt_txt="Don't mention it." />All right, I'll let this reward do the talking.

letter_block_3.title: Word Up
letter_block_3.desc: Create as many words as possible in three minutes. All the fun of spelling combined with the thrill of racing the clock!
letter_block_3.offer: Hey there, kid. <split butt_txt="Oh, hi." /> Feel like playing a little game? <split butt_txt="Games are my favorite." /> You're going to love this one. You get to spell. <split butt_txt="Ooh, I love spells!" /> Er, that's not quite what I meant. How about we just shrink you down and you start playing. You'll be re-embiggened when you're done, OK?
letter_block_3.completion: You did good, kid. <split butt_txt="I always do." />For humouring Mr. Block in this latest escapade, I'd like you to have a little extra something. <split butt_txt="Those are my favourite somethings." /> Of course, they are! Here you go, kid.

requirements.name: spell_words
requirements.desc: Spell as many words as possible in three minutes

lightgreenthumb_1.title: Lift Your Light Green Thumb
lightgreenthumb_1.desc: Learn what it takes to make trees and plants happy and healthy!
lightgreenthumb_1.offer: Feeling friendly, kid? Well that’s good. Because it’s time to learn about making nice with trees and plants! You’ll even get your very own Watering Can. You dig??
lightgreenthumb_1.completion: What’s that? I think you got a little green on your thumb!

lightgreenthumb_break_watering_can.title: Water Water Everywhere
lightgreenthumb_break_watering_can.desc: Find the breaking point of a Watering Can (or that of an Irrigator 9000). Water every Tree and Crop that's willing till you can water no more.
lightgreenthumb_break_watering_can.offer: Let's try an experiment, shall we? Let's see if you can break a Watering Can with excessive watering. Betcha can't do it. Well, we'll see. We'll see.
lightgreenthumb_break_watering_can.completion: Broken watering can, huh? I guess you showed me. <split butt_txt="I guess I did." />We didn't actually bet anything on this, but if we had, I bet it would have been to the tune of this.

lightgreenthumb_get_tree_to_level10.title: Be A Tree-Pleaser
lightgreenthumb_get_tree_to_level10.desc: Find seven trees, and visibly increase the level of their healthfulness by petting or watering. You'll need a Watering Can to do this. And your firmest Petting hand.
lightgreenthumb_get_tree_to_level10.offer: Funky-coloured thumb you've got there, kid. What shade is that? Lime? Teal? <split butt_txt="I prefer 'Chartreuse'?"> Course you do, Pickle. Say: you should put that digit to good use. How about you display your improved greenfingerliness by radically improving the health of some trees? <split butt_txt="How radically?">Well, you must have noticed that sometimes when you pet or water, the trees look lusher, more harvestable, and generally, y'know, *foliagier*?<split butt_txt="Not a word."> Not the point. But the healthier they are, the faster they'll reach full maturity, and the more fruit they'll produce. <split butt_txt="Top tip."> As you go about your greenthumbing business, make seven trees visibly healthier. No rush. Take your time - but do do it: all the nice trees love a greenthumb.
lightgreenthumb_get_tree_to_level10.completion: Hey, hot-thumbs. Did'ya know there's a shade called Hooker's Green? <split butt_txt="#49796B, right?"> Oh, um… <split butt_txt="Named after botanical artist William Hooker (1779-1832)?"> Yeah, alright kid, so you swallowed a 'pedia. Point is: you're quite the tree pleaser. The world's foliage is some per cent healthier, and all because of you. Here's a little something for your efforts.

lightgreenthumb_water_trees.title: Give some H2O love
lightgreenthumb_water_trees.desc: Trees like water. Go ahead and spread some liquid love by watering 5 Trees.
lightgreenthumb_water_trees.offer: Now that you have a Watering Can and skill with plants, could you please go and water 5 Trees? Fantastic, kid. Some of them are quite thirsty!
lightgreenthumb_water_trees.completion: Job well done! Your thumbs are getting even greener.

manor_mystery.title: Manor Mystery
manor_mystery.desc: Something is not quite right at the Manor on Hauki Seeks.
manor_mystery.offer: Have you heard of Hauki Seeks Manor? That place has always been kind of creepy, but lately it seems some really strange things have been occurring. I won't blame you if you don't want to check it out, but that person you're trying to impress might think you're pretty brave if you do.
manor_mystery.completion: Hey! you found my note! I lost it somewhere in this Manor and have been scaring people from coming in here in case someone picked it up before I could.

master_milker.title: Master Milker
master_milker.desc: Milk 7 butterflies. Hint: This task is a lot easier if you have butterfly lotion and the Butterfly Whisperer achievement.
master_milker.offer: Hey. Kid. I've got a proposition for you, but it's going to be a test of your charm, dexterity and stick-to-it-iveness. You in? You know how to milk a butterfly, right? Oh, jeez. This is going to be tougher than I thought. Okay. So first you get yourself some butterfly lotion. Got that? Well, yeah. Of course. Butterflies chafe easily. So get yourself some lotion. Wait! There's more. You're going to have to kinda charm the butterfly before you milk it. You'll figure it out. And then after you've milked the butterfly... Milk 6 more. Have fun!
master_milker.completion: Well done, kid. Here's a little something for your trouble. <split butt_txt="Thanks!" />You know what's even trickier than getting 7 vials of butterfly milk? <split butt_txt="No, what?" />Getting 7 sticks of butterfly butter. But that's a job for another day.

offerTriggers.why: milking quest after the Animal Kinship milking quest

masterchef_make_level1_recipes.title: A Reasonable Dinner
masterchef_make_level1_recipes.desc: Gumbo, Pasta & a Pickle? Why not. Using an Awesome Pot, prepare a Meat Gumbo and a nice Tasty Pasta to go with it. Oh, and a Pickle on the side. (Note: You may need to use the pot for a bit to learn the recipe for Tasty Pasta.)
masterchef_make_level1_recipes.offer: I'm getting hungry. You know what makes a nice meal? Meat Gumbo and Tasty Pasta! That's my favorite. Sure does! And with a Pickle on the side, it is a complete meal. Make me one? (Note: You may need to use the pot for a bit to learn the recipe for Tasty Pasta.)
masterchef_make_level1_recipes.completion: Oh boy! It was great of you to make me this dinner. But you know what? <split butt_txt="Uh oh" /> No, it's good. I already ate! So, you can keep the dinner ... and let me give you a little something so you know I appreciate it.

meditative_arts_with_friends.title: Multiply Your Meditation
meditative_arts_with_friends.desc: Meditate simultaneously with 10 friends using your Focusing Orb.
meditative_arts_with_friends.offer: As Cosma once muttered to herself, "Achieving oneness with the universe sometimes requires eleven-ness." Yes, the magic number at which meditation achieves its full potential!It will please Cosma greatly if you can multiply your meditation by gathering 10 fellow Glitchen and meditating together. It's very important that you all meditate at the same time!You'll each need your own Focusing Orb, and a nice quiet place to gather and free your minds to ponder the meaning of life, the universe, and everything.
meditative_arts_with_friends.completion: You feel a deep sense of peace and eleven-ness. <split butt_txt="Ah...I do." />You have made Cosma a very happy giant — if a giant could be said to feel an emotion as simplistic and corporeal as 'happy'.  In return for the great contentment you have brought her, she offers you all the following reward.

meditativearts_get_max_relax.title: Relax to the Max
meditativearts_get_max_relax.desc: Use a Focusing Orb to fetter your unfettered thoughts and achieve the elusive state of Max Relax. (Receive 50 mood in one meditation)
meditativearts_get_max_relax.offer: So you're coming along in the Meditative Arts, kid. But have you achieved Max Relax? If you're not sure, then you haven't. So grab your Focusing Orb, clear your head, let your mind and your nether bits feel free, and try hitting 50 mood in one try.
meditativearts_get_max_relax.completion: You did it! Max Relax! <split butt_txt="I feel squishy." />That's the best part. Congratulations, kid. And enjoy this little reward. You deserve it.

meditativearts_maintain_energy_in_wintry.title: Cold Comfort
meditativearts_maintain_energy_in_wintry.desc: Chillax to the max. Go to Wintry Place and use your Focusing Orb to replenish your energy for a full minute - without leaving. (Hint: The secret entrances to Wintry Place are in Northwest Passage and in Newcot Close.)
meditativearts_maintain_energy_in_wintry.offer: You ready to test your spiritual chilly mettle, kid? This will be a test of your ability to focus your meditation under mind-numbing duress. Locate the secret entrance to Wintry Place. Then use your Focusing Orb to replenish your energy for a whole minute. A full minute… without leaving that frozen wasteland. Leave part way through, and you'll have to start from scratch. Well, it's easier to regain energy with Focused Meditation, but if you haven't got that, just meditate the normal way. And don't worry. It'll be a blast. No. But you should do it anyway.
meditativearts_maintain_energy_in_wintry.completion: You did it! A whole minute of intensive meditation! <split butt_txt="So... very... c-c-c-cold." /> Get your chilblains out of here, kid. But before you go, here's the customary little something. Put it toward your frostbite treatment.

requirements.name: wintry_place_meditation
requirements.desc: Replenish 60 energy by meditating in Wintry Place

meditativearts_meditate_for_time_period.title: Blue Ocean
meditativearts_meditate_for_time_period.desc: Meditate for a cumulative total of one minute. You will need a Focusing Orb (available from any Street Spirit who sells Hardware.)
meditativearts_meditate_for_time_period.offer: Namaste.Ah, meditation. Get yourself a Focusing Orb and then Meditate for a cumulative total of one minute. You'll feel much better!
meditativearts_meditate_for_time_period.completion: Well done! I bet you feel much better. Keep on meditating! It's the true path ... Namaste!

meditativearts_meditation_station.title: Meditation Station
meditativearts_meditation_station.desc: Visit the same street at least once every 6 game days and meditate for 60 seconds. Do so on 11 game days.
meditativearts_meditation_station.offer: Ah, the virtues of meditation know no bounds. But y’know, meditation without practice is kind of, like, spacing out every now and then. I mean it's nice, but... You know that favorite spot of yours? Well yeah, of course there’s a few, but pick one and meditate there for the next 11 game days and then we’ll talk real enlightenment.
meditativearts_meditation_station.completion: How ya feeling, chum? <split butt_txt="Ohmmmmmmmmmmm">Well, there you go. The best part is that you can keep finding new places to practice and the rewards are just the same. <split butt_txt="Nice!">Here’s some stuff for you. Not that you need it - you transcendent being, you. <split butt_txt="Thanks anyway.">

requirements.name: meditation_station_days
requirements.desc: Meditate on the same street on 11 game days

offerTriggers.why: Meditative Arts series; no giver survives (familiar turn-in)

mental_block.title: Mental Block
mental_block.desc: Create a path to the exit by dropping blocks along the way.
mental_block.offer: Everything ok? You seem somewhat puzzled. <split butt_txt="Do I?" />  Puzzled, confused, perhaps a little stuck?<split butt_txt="I feel fine." />  Well, it's possible I'm seeing into your future. Ah, yes. That's it. My intuition tells me you'll soon be feeling a mental block of sorts. Are you ready?
mental_block.completion: Well, was I right? Were you confused, puzzled … confuzzled? Doesn't matter. Whatever you felt, it looks like you're over it now. Great job!

mental_block_2.title: Mental Block 2
mental_block_2.desc: Create a path to the exit by dropping blocks along the way.
mental_block_2.offer: You look bedrazzled. <split butt_txt="What … ?" /> You know, bedrazzled, confuzzled, disorientled. I know, I dazzle you with my infinite knowledge of words. <split butt_txt="I don't think they're …" /> But of course, you don't think. You've got another mental block. Ready to tackle it?
mental_block_2.completion: You sure cleared up that block of a mess. Now fluster down and enjoy your reward.

mental_block_rem.title: Mental Block
mental_block_rem.desc: Create a path to the exit by dropping blocks along the way.
mental_block_rem.offer: Are you ready to reminisce Mental Block?
mental_block_rem.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.
mental_block_rem.offerNote: canOffer: walk_speed_3 and jump_2; an hour after part 1 and after the last repeat or fail

mini_me_mini_you.title: Mini Me, Mini You!
mini_me_mini_you.desc: Give seven different characters their likeness in cubimal form.
mini_me_mini_you.offer: "There are no grades of vanity, there are only grades of ability in concealing it..." and nothing makes it harder to conceal vanity than the cheap thrill of possessing a cubimal which looks just like you.<split butt_txt="A cubimal that looks like me?!" />Hold your horses, vainy-pants! No-one said anything about a cubimal that looks like you.<split butt_txt="Aww. What then?" />Many of the inhabitants of Ur have cubimals that look like them. Also, low self-esteem. It would greatly improve the mood of the world if their vanity were tickled a bit.<split butt_txt="I'm a champion tickler!" />That you are! But don't get too touchy-feely. I just need you to find 7 different cubimals and deliver them to the Ur-inhabitant they resemble. Can you do that for me?<split butt_txt="Do I get a cubimal that looks like me?" />No. But maybe some other stuff. And the pride that comes from a job well done.<split butt_txt="Sigh. Ok, I'll do it!" />
mini_me_mini_you.completion: What-ho! By my calculations the collective mood of Ur has been raised precisely 0.324%, thanks to your hard work.<split butt_txt="That's not much!" />It's significantly more than zero.<split butt_txt="You have an odd way of looking at things." />Perhaps, but... look, do you want these rewards or not?<split butt_txt="Yes please!" />

requirements.name: npcs_given_cubimals
requirements.desc: Give 7 cubimals to the NPCs they depict

offerTriggers.why: Cubimal giving; no gate in source

mining_break_fancy_pick.title: Hard Rock Miner
mining_break_fancy_pick.desc: Breaking a regular pick is easy. But to break a Fancy Pick through heavy Mining means you'll really have to give 'er. Possibly till you quiver.
mining_break_fancy_pick.offer: So, judging by those arms of yours, I guess you don't work out much. Well, I was curious to see if you could break a Fancy Pick through excessive Mining. My magic 9-ball says "probably not". I know. Why don't you show it a thing or two and break that Fancy Pick of yours going miner forty-niner on some rock's behind. Think of all the ore you'll end up with, and maybe something else for your goodie bag.
mining_break_fancy_pick.completion: By Mab's false teeth! That's one broken pick. This should more than cover the cost of a new one, or maybe something else you've had your great big eyes on.

mining_deplete_rocks_in_time_period.title: Another Day Older and Deeper In Debt
mining_deplete_rocks_in_time_period.desc: Use your Pick or Fancy Pick to wear 5 Rocks down to nary a nub in just one game day.
mining_deplete_rocks_in_time_period.offer: If you were to be able to Mine your way through 5 entire Rocks in just one game day, I think we'd have to come up with a cool nickname for you. Any thoughts? How's about we let you stick to digging and I'll stick to naming things? Get pickin'.
mining_deplete_rocks_in_time_period.completion: Woo! You just whaled through 5 Rocks in one day! I think I'm going to call you Igneous Ike. <split butt_txt="Best you could come up with?" /> I'M TIRED. Here. I'll give you this little reward, you keep quiet about my little lapse of wit. <split butt_txt="A bribe?" /> Let's call it a consultant fee.

mining_mine_in_time_period.title: Giv'r 'til you Shiver
mining_mine_in_time_period.desc: Pick up your Pick or Fancy Pick and mine 15 times in just 5 minutes.
mining_mine_in_time_period.offer: Hey kid, ever think about going John Henry on some poor unsuspecting rock's noodle? Well, if you Mine 15 times in just 5 minutes, I will bestow upon you a suitable reward for your efforts. But only if you're successful. Merciless mockery will ensue.
mining_mine_in_time_period.completion: That was some zippy Mining. I could barely see those little arms of yours move. <split butt_txt="These arms don't like being called little." /> Aw. Use this little reward to buy them something pretty.

mining_mine_rocks.title: Dullite, Beryl and Sparkly
mining_mine_rocks.desc: Mine from Dullite, Beryl and Sparkly rocks until you have 17, 13 and 11 ore chunks respectively. You'll have an easier time finding rocks to mine in Ilmenskie Caverns, Ilmenskie Deeps, Groddle Heights and Alakol. You'll need a pick too, so visit any Street Spirit who sells Hardware or Alchemical Goods.
mining_mine_rocks.offer: You little miner, you! Go get a pick from a Street Spirit who sells Hardware or Alchemical Goods, and then mine you some ore: get 17 Dullite, 13 Beryl and 11 Sparkly ore chunks.
mining_mine_rocks.completion: Well done! Hope your arms aren't too tired. If you mine enough, you probably want to get the refining skill too (requires element handling). Here's a little something for your trouble.

multiplayer_races.title: Multiplayer Race
multiplayer_races.desc: Race another player to see who's best!
multiplayer_races.offer: Seriously, this is fun, just do it.

neighbor_gifts.title: The nicest day in the neighborhood
neighbor_gifts.desc: Leave 5 gifts of at least one item to the butlers of 5 different neighbors
neighbor_gifts.offer:
Have you been over to your neighbors lately? I'm sure they'd love the visit and everyone loves getting kind gifts from their neighbors!
Why don't you pop on over to 5 different neighbors and leave a gift with their butler? Anything you have on you.It'll be the nicest day in the neighborhood!
neighbor_gifts.completion: Great goodness, it's a beautiful day in the neighborhood!You are a kind neighbor to have indeed.

numismatic_hustle.title: The Numismatic Hustle
numismatic_hustle.desc: Go to Rainbow Run and collect 30 coins in less than 30 seconds.
numismatic_hustle.offer: Psst. I said "Psst." Do you like being in a good mood? You like running, jumping and, incidentally, achieving great things? No need for the lip, chum. I'm offering you a rare challenge. See if you can collect 30 coins in less than 30 seconds in the infamous Rainbow Run. I'll zip you straight there if you accept this job, then I'll zip you back here when your time is up. Ready... steady...
numismatic_hustle.completion: I like the way you move, kid. I don't usually do this, but I'm giving you a little bonus prize. Don't tell anybody.

omg_bacon.title: OMG, Bacon!
omg_bacon.desc: Take a picture that contains 3 Piggies in 3 delicious forms.
omg_bacon.offer: Are you into meat? Take it any way you like. But in the meantime, how about you expand your horizons by snapping a Piggy, a Hog-Tied Piggy and a Piglet all in the same photo?Yeah kid - it's all about context.
omg_bacon.completion: This may be one of the meatiest pictures you've taken, kid. <split butt_txt="One can dream." />But … where's the bacon? Next time, I guess. Psst - don't spend this all in one place.

orld_ugs_esara.title: Chasing Hubba Dubba Hugs
orld_ugs_esara.desc: Travel to the following streets within Besara and get one hug each from three different players. Tremit Rub Patomi Bunya Krios Palm Be careful some strange Glitches can hug a little to tightly!
orld_ugs_esara.offer: Did you know the world of Ur is built on Hugs?<split butt_txt="er....Sure?" /> Well it is true, a rock never fibs! It is doubly important to Hug strangers and receive their cosmic hugs! Are you ready to do your Hugglily part? <split butt_txt="Its Hug time" /> Perfect, Besara hug levels are low, get there on the double and gather allies to give you hugs.<split butt_txt="On my way" />
orld_ugs_esara.completion: Now don't you feel all warm and fuzzy? <split butt_txt="Warm yes, fuzzy?" /> Now that the cockles of Ur's heart is now full you can abstain from hugging for a little while.<split butt_txt="cockles?" /> In return for your gathering of all the huggers we offer you these fine rewards.

phantom_glitch.title: Notice the Unnoticeable
phantom_glitch.desc: Search the world for evidence of ghosts.
phantom_glitch.offer:
In the mood for a good ghost story?
<split butt_txt="Always." />
OK, do you just ever find yourself daydreaming about nothing in particular?
<split butt_txt="Wait, this is a ghost story?" />
Be patient, kid; I’m getting there. When you're daydreaming about one thing or another, and suddenly you snap out of it because you've, say, dropped something on your foot, where do those thoughts go?
<split butt_txt="I dunno."/>
I should clarify—where do they go if you're a Giant whose imagination can create whole worlds? You see, kid, there are some who say that a parallel Ur exists somewhere out there, a shadowy world of half-extant musings and figments not quite remembered, but never entirely forgotten.
<split butt_txt="Do you think they're right?"/>
Well, I don’t know for sure. But I do know this: sometimes you feel a chill in the room when no one's there, or see something out of the corner of your eye that you can't quite describe. What is it? Maybe you should put on your ghost hunting hat and find out. If you peer into dark places, you just… might…
<split butt_txt="Just might what?"/>
Just might what what? Sorry, I must have zoned out there for a second. What was I talking about?
phantom_glitch.completion:
Where did he go?
<split butt_txt="I dunno." />
Well, champ, at least he left you something to remember him by.
<split butt_txt="Yeah…" />
Cheer up, maybe you'll see him again someday.
<split butt_txt="Do you think?" />
Anything is possible. What is not forgotten is never really lost.
phantom_glitch.acceptLabel: Never mind. It's ghost hunting time!

picto_pattern.title: Picto-Pattern
picto_pattern.desc: Add and subtract until you reach 11.
picto_pattern.offer: Pop Quiz! How many Giants are there? <split butt_txt="Eleven!" /> Isn't that such a lovely prime number? Sure there are other numbers out there like 5 or 29, but nothing compares to the heavenly ring that 11 makes. <split butt_txt="I agree!" /> Well, if you are following me, I guess you can count. Want to turn some numbers into 11?
picto_pattern.completion: Whew, who knew counting numbers could be so tough. Especially counting to a number that exceeds the number of fingers you have.

pied_pepper.title: The Pied Pepper
pied_pepper.desc: Show tribute to our Zilloweeny ancestor by backing oodles of pie, dropping them off and then paying tribute.
pied_pepper.offer: Hey kid, you know that tale of the Pied Piper right?<split butt_txt="Sure" />Well I bet you've never heard of the guy who baked all those pies!<split butt_txt="I don't think that's the story..." />Kid, you wouldn't be here if that man didn't bake his little heart out every Zilloween! Think of all the mice that got to dance!<split butt_txt="Yah... YAH! THE MICE!" />Let's pay a little tribute to him, what do you say?<split butt_txt="Sounds like something I could get behind!" />Good! I want you to bake 10 pies, and deliver them to 10 places. Once you are done, sprinkle some pepper on that place that has water for rememberance.<split butt_txt="Kindda getting choked up" />It's alright kid, you're doing that pie maker proud. FOR THE DANCING MICE!
pied_pepper.completion: It's beautiful kid, just beautiful. The way that pepper floats on the water brings a tear to my eye and a runny nose. Probably because I sniffed it. Makes you feel good don't it?! Zille is very pleased.

play_musicblocks.title: Blocks That Rock
play_musicblocks.desc: Get out there and amp up other players' moods: 25 musicblocks, 25 players, 1 game day.
play_musicblocks.offer: So you have quite a collection of tunes now, huh? <split butt_txt="Yeah, I'm a regular DJ." /> Prove your metal, then, MC Glitch! Play 1 of each musicblock to 25 different players in 1 game day. <split butt_txt="Their ears will be ringing!" />
play_musicblocks.completion: Not bad! You're ready for your own 100-watt AM radio show. Okay, maybe FM. Anyway, hope you like the sound of your rewards, kid!

potionmaking_make_and_use_essence_of_hol.title: Make and use Essence of Hole potion

potionmaking_make_different_potions_in_a.title: Epicly Perilous Potian Trial of Perilousness
potionmaking_make_different_potions_in_a.desc: Using a Cauldron, make seven different potions in a single game day.
potionmaking_make_different_potions_in_a.offer: Hm, what have we here? Intermediate Potion-Maker, is it? In days of yore… <split butt_txt="Yaaaawn" /> Nono, not yawn, kid, YORE. In days of yore, no potion-maker was taken seriously until they undertook the Epic Perilous Potian Trial of Perilousness. <split butt_txt="Oooh, that sounds exciting!" /> Oh it is. Are you prepared for the Epicly Perilous Potian Trial of Perilousness? Have you girded your loins for epic peril? <split butt_txt="Consider me girded." /> Right. Go forth then… and create seven unique potions. <split butt_txt="Is that it?" />…In one day. <split butt_txt="Well, I'll TRY…" />
potionmaking_make_different_potions_in_a.completion: You survived!  <split butt_txt="Well, yes, it was…" /> Tough? I know. Perilous? Yes, it's legendary for that. Epic? You wouldn't be the first to say it. <split butt_txt="…Pretty easy?" /> Wow. You've come a long way, Potion Maker. I only hope you're not above accepting a little benediction for your quest? I thought not. Here you go…

requirements.name: different_potions_made
requirements.desc: Make 7 different potions in one game day

potionmaking_make_potions.title: Potion Detector
potionmaking_make_potions.desc: Create five Potions with your Cauldron. Take all the time you need.
potionmaking_make_potions.offer: What ho, adventurer, where wandrest thou? Odd's Bodkins, art thou in search of a quest? A Potionny Quest perchance, think'ye? Ah, you got me. I was just trying something more potion-appropriate, y'know? You got it! Speaking of getting it, you got a Cauldron to go with your shiny new Potion-Making skill, right? Well if you haven't - get one. Then bubble yourself five potions. Doesn't matter how long you take, as long as there are five of them. Got it?
potionmaking_make_potions.completion: Good morrow, sorcerer. <split butt_txt="What up." /> So you doubled, doubled, toiled and troubled yourself to make five magical potions, did you? <split butt_txt="You bet your gadzooks I did." /> I don't think that word means what you think it means. However, a noble attempt. And for that, my little one, here's a magical little reward.

purple_journey_north.title: A Purple Journey North
purple_journey_north.desc: Acquire a Purple Flower and venture to the mountains of Aranna to munch it.
purple_journey_north.offer: Say, you look like the type that has a wistful affection for the past.The type that enjoys hearing of the old days, before the Age of Friendly, if there ever was such a time.They were the days of wonder and whimsy, when imagination flowed through your veins thicker than Hooch.I'm told the era lives on in the Purple Flower, but that only those who journey to the mountains of Aranna can truly enjoy it.Find the flower and go north, young creature, to experience imagination like it used to be.Be gone!
purple_journey_north.completion: Didn't think you were going to go through with it kid.<split butt_txt="YOLO" />Well, was it worth all that trekking?<split butt_txt="Do my hands look big to you?" />Nuff' said, kid. Nuff' said.

requirements.name: purple_journey_munch
requirements.desc: Munch a Purple Flower in the mountains of Aranna

puzzle_level_color_blockage.title: Color Unblocking
puzzle_level_color_blockage.desc: Unblock your way to the exit, collecting rewards along the way.
puzzle_level_color_blockage.offer: You look like a fashionable young glitch. "On trend", "in-the-know", so to speak. <split butt_txt="Yes, yes I am." /> Indeed. But, have you heard of color blocking? It's all the rage. <split butt_txt="Oh?" /> Oh brother. Yes! But, I'm not actually here to talk to you about fashion. I'm here to tell you that you're about to learn about color blocking, or perhaps I should say "color unblocking". If you're as intrigued as you appear puzzled, then I'd say it's time to go!
puzzle_level_color_blockage.completion: I see you are well-versed in the art of color unblocking. Well done. Although, in my opinion, a little color suits you. Oh, and here's a little something for you to play with!

puzzle_level_color_blockage_rem.title: Color Unblocking
puzzle_level_color_blockage_rem.desc: Unblock your way to the exit, collecting rewards along the way.
puzzle_level_color_blockage_rem.offer: Are you ready to reminisce Color Unblocking?
puzzle_level_color_blockage_rem.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.

puzzle_level_light_perspective.title: Walk Toward the Light
puzzle_level_light_perspective.desc: Use different colored lights to reveal the one, true path.
puzzle_level_light_perspective.offer: Pssst. You there. How are your eyes? <split butt_txt="Huh?" /> What I mean to say is, do your eyes work properly? Can you see all the colors of the rainbow? <split butt_txt="Um, sure. I believe so." /> Good. Good! Because, where you’re going, you’re going to need sharp eyes. <split butt_txt="If you say so!" /> I do. And remember, go toward the light!
puzzle_level_light_perspective.completion: Colorific! Unless my eyes are playing tricks on me, I’d say it looks like you deserve a reward.

puzzle_level_light_perspective_rem.title: Walk Toward the Light
puzzle_level_light_perspective_rem.desc: Use different colored lights to reveal the one, true path.
puzzle_level_light_perspective_rem.offer: Are you ready to reminisce Walk Toward the Light?
puzzle_level_light_perspective_rem.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.
puzzle_level_light_perspective_rem.offerNote: canOffer: walk_speed_3 and jump_2; an hour after part 1, after the last repeat and after a fail

questswhere_the_heart_isjs.title: Where the Heart Is
questswhere_the_heart_isjs.desc: Take a snapshot of your home interior.
questswhere_the_heart_isjs.offer: One of the best things about having a home is making it your own. <split butt_txt="Yeah, mine is pretty neat." /> It is! And as you expand and decorate your home, it will become even more a reflection of you.<split butt_txt="You know, that's true!" />Why not immortalize your current home decor with a lovely snapshot? If you feel like bragging - you can post it publicly!
questswhere_the_heart_isjs.completion: Wow - really love what you've done with the place! Imagine what it will look like in the future! <split butt_txt="Yeah. Maybe some new carpet?" />I'll leave you to your decorating. Maybe this will help?

radiant_glare.title: Radiant Glare
radiant_glare.desc: Hone your skills as you travel toward the radiant glare above.
radiant_glare.offer: Young Glitch, you once walked toward the light, proving your eyes are sharp. But, without practice, your skills may become dull.<split butt_txt="Makes sense." /> Hone your skills as you move up toward the radiant glare. And, remember, "Do or do not … there is no try."
radiant_glare.completion: A wise Glitch once said, "True mastery of a skill was only the beginning step to understanding it."<split butt_txt="Mmmkay." /> You are one step closer to mastery.  Understand? Either way, you deserve this reward.

radiant_glare_rem.title: Radiant Glare
radiant_glare_rem.desc: Hone your skills as you travel toward the radiant glare above.
radiant_glare_rem.offer: Are you ready to reminisce Radiant Glare?
radiant_glare_rem.completion: Welcome back, {pc_label}. I hope you enjoyed yourself.
radiant_glare_rem.offerNote: canOffer: walk_speed_3 and jump_2; an hour after part 1 and after the last repeat or fail

rannacramble.title: Aranna Scramble
rannacramble.desc: Take a hike through Aranna to care for the animals and trees. Nibble from 7 piggies, milk 11 Butterflies, pet and water 17 trees, squeeze 23 chickens, get at least 1 Super Harvest from them, and incubate 3 seasoned eggs in a game day.
rannacramble.offer: Whoa there, I say whoa there! <split butt_txt="I'm not livestock- what can I do for you?" /> There is a mountainous and forested region, that could use your loving touch. <split butt_txt="Like where?" /> Aranna, my friend- Aranna needs you. <split butt_txt="How so?" /> The trees and animals throughout Aranna need a friendly Glitch like you to give them your full attention. Are you game? Good. You have 1 game day to complete this task. <split butt_txt="Ready!" /> Go!
rannacramble.completion: You did it- you provided your loving touch to the residents of Aranna and for that, they thank you with this substantial reward. Huzzah!

refining_grind_ore_to_elements.title: Perfectly Refined
refining_grind_ore_to_elements.desc: Obtain 50 of each Element by grinding down some ore chunks. You'll need a Grinder (available from any Street Spirit who sells Hardware or Alchemical Goods) and an Elemental Pouch (but you probably already have one of those).
refining_grind_ore_to_elements.offer: Congratulations on learning the refining skill. Now let's put it to use: break down enough ore chunks to get 50 of each of the four Elements.
refining_grind_ore_to_elements.completion: Well done! Grind lots of ore so you have the Elements to get ahead with Alchemy.

refining_refine_ore_in_time_period.title: The Daily Grind
refining_refine_ore_in_time_period.desc: Use your Grinder to refine 200 Chunks of Ore in 2 minutes. You can do it!
refining_refine_ore_in_time_period.offer: There are some who say it can't be done. I'm talking about using your Grinder to refine 200 Chunks of Ore in 2 minutes. We'll see about that. Ready?
refining_refine_ore_in_time_period.completion: Wow. 200 Chunks of Ore in 2 minutes. To be honest, I didn't think it could be done. <split butt_txt="I done did it." /> You done did. Here's a little reward. Keep this up, and you'll be going places, my little chelloveck.

remember_ghosts_1.title: Remember the Rememberable
remember_ghosts_1.desc: Dust off your Faded Heart and track down the Phantom Glitch's new haunts.
remember_ghosts_1.offer:
oooooooo...
<split butt_txt="Excuse me?" />
ooOOOoOOOOOO!!!
<split butt_txt="What the..?" />
OK, OK. It's me. Had you fooled, didn't I, kid?
<split butt_txt="Fooled? It sounded like you were in pain." />
Thanks for your concern, but I'm trying to help you remember the rememberable. Do you recall that little ghost hunt a while back? You helped our phantom friend find fulfillment in his half-extant state.
<split butt_txt="Little? That hunt took forever!" />
Well, if it weren't for you, our aimless apparition would still be shouting whispers at passersby. But your observance has helped his spirit expand. Think of it this way: you gave him the capacity to spread out his haunts, and as you remember him more, his spirit manifests itself more and more until...
<split butt_txt="Until what?" />
Not sure. But that Faded Heart he gave you should help jog your memory.
remember_ghosts_1.completion:
Great job, kid. You found his new haunts.
<split butt_txt="What is forgotten is never really lost." />
Whoever told you that is a genius.
<split butt_txt="So what's next?" />
I don't remember. But I do have something to make sure your ghastly good deed doesn't go unrewarded.

requirements.name: faded_heart_remembered
requirements.desc: Find the Phantom Glitch's new haunts.

remember_ghosts_1.acceptLabel: Where did I put that thing?

remoteherdkeeping_fill_up_meat_collector.title: Got Milk?
remoteherdkeeping_fill_up_meat_collector.desc: And after you got Milk, got Meat? Get a Butterfly Milker and a Meat Collector, install them in your yard, then set them to milking and harvesting until they're full up.
remoteherdkeeping_fill_up_meat_collector.offer: I've been watching you kid. You're busy and important. You're on the move, and you've got better places to be than hanging around the house waiting to harvest butterflies and piggies. You need to get yourself a patented, practically dumdum-proof Butterfly Milker and Meat Collector. Set them up in your yard, and I'll check back with you when they're full up, mkay?
remoteherdkeeping_fill_up_meat_collector.completion: Looks like that Butterfly Milker is as full as it gets. And if that Meat Collector were any more full, it would be... really, really full. Here's an idea you maybe haven't tried: give one of your Butterfly Milks a good shake and see what happens. Nothing happens. It just makes other people uncomfortable.

rising_moon.title: Rising Moon
rising_moon.desc: Moons are for mooning, so get one and use it to moon 5 different players. You'll also need an Emotional Bear to go with your moon (see if you can figure out how they go together), and you can get both from any Street Spirit who sells Hardware.
rising_moon.offer: You look glum, chum. You know what might make you feel better? Other than that. A good old-fashioned mooning. You heard me. Get yourself a moon and moon some other players. Moons can be thin on the ground, so you may have to buy one from a Street Spirit who sells Hardware. Once you have a moon, and combine it with an Emotional Bear, you can moon with impunity. It's a certified hoot. And tell you what. Even though mooning is its own reward, if you moon 5 other players, I'll give you a little something special. What do you say?
rising_moon.completion: Didn't I tell you, kid? Good times, right? <split butt_txt="Indeed!" /> Here's a little something extra, just because I'm a nice rock. <split butt_txt="Thanks!" />Remember: You can't moon without a moon. Keep it handy!

offerTriggers.why: emotional bear + moon, both sold by street spirits

rook_egg_smash.title: Prove Your Rook-Fighting Mettle
rook_egg_smash.desc: Find and smash a rook Egg. I will teleport you in to the Rooks' Woods when you are ready. Beware: they often protect their nests … (You need a Pick, Fancy Pick or a Hatchet to start this quest.)
rook_egg_smash.offer: Let's get serious. Really serious.<split butt_txt="Always" />The Rook threatens us all and you are getting to the age where you can help in the fight.<split butt_txt="I do feel older" />As a test run, I need you to infiltrate the Rooks' Woods and smash one of their eggs.
rook_egg_smash.completion: Well done, well done! It's only one egg, but every one makes a difference. I will call on you again to continue your training when you seem ready for the next step.<split butt_txt="OK" />But for now, let's get you out of here …

rook_hall.title: It's Educational II
rook_hall.desc: Get your learn on in the Museum of the Rook.
rook_hall.offer: Now, this way please. Let us enter the museum.
rook_hall.completion: You have seen all there is to see here. Do you now feel prepared to do battle with the Rook?<split butt_txt="I'm not sure." />I understand your trepidation, but you must simply remember this…<split butt_txt="Yes?" />The Rook, while incredibly powerful, is vulnerable to the attacks of Martial Imagination. Before you can harm the Rook, you must use a Focusing Orb to stun it.<split butt_txt="Focusing Orb. Stun. Got it." />Once the Rook has been stunned, the Pious Glitch can prime a shrine, turning the donations of others into powerful attacks.<split butt_txt="Prime. Donations. Attack. OK." />I believe you are now ready. Go, rally the forces of imagination in defence of Ur! And may the Giants be with you.

rook_hall_start.title: It's Educational
rook_hall_start.desc: Travel to the Mezzanine in Jethimadh Tower accessible via Tower St. West and speak to Greeterbot Sentry G-42.
rook_hall_start.offer: Say, how do you feel about learning? OK, so how do you feel about ancient artifacts of the past and dire prophetic warnings of the future, with a little art history mixed in? Let me guess, you're worried I'm going to send you on another wacky adventure. Well, don't worry—I'm not going to shrink you down or send you into some spooky woods or make you ride a roller-skating camel again.Really? Well maybe we haven't done that one yet. Anyway, this time we're going to the museum in the Mezzanine of Jethimadh Tower, accessible from Tower St. West. We're going to learn about the Rook. Yes, but don't worry. The museum is perfectly safe. For legal reasons, though, just on the outside chance that something even slightly bad happens, you'll need to get your parents to sign some indemnity forms. Good point. Well, I'm sure it'll be fine. Like I said, the chances are extremely low that you'll be horrifically mangled beyond recognition, so get a move on, champ!
rook_hall_start.completion: Welcome, young one, to the ancient and venerable Museum of the Rook. I am Greeterbot Sentry G-42, humble docent of this establishment. How may I be of service?<split butt_txt="A magic rock told me talk to you." />Then it is time: time for you to learn of the Rook! Time for you to take up the fight against those dreadful beasts, the fight for imagination—nay, for Ur itself!<split butt_txt="Me?" />Yes, for if not you, then who else?

rube_spy.title: The Wrizzards and The Rube
rube_spy.desc: Help The Rube by finding and clicking all the Wrizzards hiding in his yard.
rube_spy.offer: Hey {pc_label}! Wanna make a tra … I mean, do you wanna help me out? <split butt_txt="Mmmaybe?" /> One of my good friends, The Rube, traded a super rare gem for a jar of Wrizzards, and accidentally dropped it in his yard when he got home. <split butt_txt="Wrizzards?" /> That’s right, Wrizzards. And, now they've gotten into his stash and he can't seem to find any of them! Help a Rube out, will ya?
rube_spy.completion: You got them all?! Thank ya, thank ya! <split butt_txt="Welcome!" />Now there’s much more space in The Rube’s yard to put stuff! <split butt_txt="Good! I guess?!" /> Oh, yeah. More items means more trades, my friend!
rube_spy.offerNote: rube_visited_home event; offered once you have traded with The Rube

saucery_make_level1_recipes.title: Sauce Trifecta
saucery_make_level1_recipes.desc: Make a Mild Sauce, a Cheezy Sauce, and a deliciously enigmatic Sweet 'n Sour Sauce. Remember: A Saucepan is a must-have for making sauces.
saucery_make_level1_recipes.offer: So, you fancy yourself a saucier, kid? I like your moxie. Whatever moxie is. So here's the deal. Who doesn't? You grab yourself a Saucepan and simmer up a Mild Sauce and a Cheesy Sauce. Easy, huh? Then let's make this interesting. Cook up some Sweet 'n Sour Sauce.. It's real exotic, that stuff. Got all that?
saucery_make_level1_recipes.completion: These sauces you made ... Not bad. A few lumps, but it'll do. You show promise, kid. I'm keeping my eye on you. Here's a lil' something.

saucery_make_level2_recipes.title: Get Sauced
saucery_make_level2_recipes.desc: Go crazy with the sauce. Use a Saucepan to make a Tangy Sauce, a Wicked Bolognese Sauce and a Creamy Catsup. Tasty on their own, they're also key ingredients in Meat Tetrazzini, Tasty Pasta and Expensive Grilled Cheese.
saucery_make_level2_recipes.offer: There are people, and I won't name names, but people who fail to take sauce seriously. I'm afraid so. They assume it's just a sauce, and not a path to something else. I don't care for your tone, but get a Saucepan and use it to make a Tangy Sauce, a Wicked Bolognese Sauce and a Creamy Catsup, and we'll see if maybe a little sauce will spill your way.
saucery_make_level2_recipes.completion: Now you've done it. You've gone and made a Tangy Sauce, a Wicked Bolognese Sauce and a Creamy Catsup. Now you're ready to make Meat Tetrazzini, Tasty Pasta and Expensive Grilled Cheese. I'd tell you to put this towards chef school, but it looks like you're doing fine on your own.

say_cheese.title: Say Cheese
say_cheese.offer: Looks like you're all set to take pictures! <split butt_txt="Sure does, smart guy." /> Smart... but am I beautiful? Anyway, you should practice taking pictures. Why not practice on yourself?<split butt_txt="Doesn't seem that hard... " />Allright then, let's see how you look on film!
say_cheese.completion: Not too shabby! <split butt_txt="I work out." />Practice does make perfect! Next time, you can point the camera at something else. For now, take this!

send_mail.title: Play by Mail
send_mail.desc: Make someone feel special by using a mailbox to send them an item. (You can also use the Butler on your home street - you'll receive one at level 3!)
send_mail.offer: Pssst. Hey, kid! How do you feel about raindrops on roses? <split butt_txt="I’m for them." />Whiskers on kittens? <split butt_txt="Who doesn’t like those?" />Bright copper kettles and warm woollen mittens? Brown paper packages tied up with string? <split butt_txt="Why, these are a few of my favourite things!" />I dig the enthusiasm, kid. But it’s the last item I want to talk to you about: packages, whence they came and where they’re going. <split butt_txt="Where are they going?" />Wherever you send 'em, champ! You may have noticed your Butler's ability to handle mail and some stately mailboxes scattered here and there around the world. These are your links to the GIGPDS and its team of expert delivery frogs. <split butt_txt="Gigapids?" />Don’t try to pronounce it, kid. You’ll hurt yourself. Just say “General Inter-Giant Postal Delivery Service.” How about you try out this handy service and mail someone an item? <split butt_txt="OK, I’ll do it.">That’s the spirit! One more thing: you can only send mail to friends. You do have friends, right? <split butt_txt="I have many friends." />Of course! Who wouldn’t want to be friends with a delightful Glitch like yourself? Now get out there and brighten someone’s day!
send_mail.completion: That wasn’t so difficult, was it? <split butt_txt="Not difficult at all!" /> Good! Here’s a fun piece of history for you, kid: Friendly imagined the GIGPDS to help close friends keep in touch. Originally mail was delivered by bats—bats being Friendly’s symbol or avatar or mascot or whatever. <split butt_txt="So what happened?" /> Well, the bats had this troubling tendency to latch on to the faces of mail recipients and refuse to let go. They were just excited to have made a new friend, but let me tell you, in those days it was not uncommon to see a Glitch running frantically around Groddle Meadow, waving his or her arms wildly with a serious case of bat-face. <split butt_txt="That sounds horrible." /> Horrible, yes. Horrible and also very funny. Honestly, sometimes I miss the bats, although the frogs are nice too.

slice_of_pie.title: A slice of Pie
slice_of_pie.desc: An unfortunate accident put a stain on the relationship between the Rangers and the Bureaucrats.  Time to help!
slice_of_pie.offer: *sigh I love my job, helping keep Ur organized, but some days I have regrets.  <split butt_txt="Go on" />Many cycles ago,  I was very good friends with a Bureaucrat named Henrique.   <split butt_txt="Henrique?" />It's not a typical Bureaucrat name, but he isn't your typical paper pusher either.  Anyway, I decided to throw a party so that he could meet some of the other Rangers and we could start building some bridges.   <split butt_txt="It's always nice to meet new people..." />I completely agree!  Sure, we were imagined by the giants to do different things, but that's no reason we can't be friends!   <split butt_txt="And the party?" />It was great, until it became a disaster.  The butterfly band was great.  We were dancing up a storm.  Until the pie. <split butt_txt="What can be bad about pie?" />The giants imagined the Bureaucrats to like order, to keep things in line, to always have enough staples, to keep things clean. <split butt_txt="And the pie?" />After pulling off a great full-gainer, I hit the edge of the table.  The pie arced through the air  and landed square on Henrique's boss's brand new tie. <split butt_txt="Uh oh." />Uh oh is right.  They all stood up straight and marched right out of the party.  Henrique has not spoken to me since. <split butt_txt="Really?" />Not a peep.  I still feel awful about the pie on the tie.  Say... could you help me?<split butt_txt="I'd love to" />Great.  Take this card I wrote.  It just needs the signatures of some other Rangers.  If you could then deliver it to a Bureaucrat, it will make its way to Henrique.<split butt_txt="I'm on it" />Oh fantastic, this means so much to me.
slice_of_pie.completion: What is this?<split butt_txt="A note for Henrique" />Hmmm.  It is in the appropriate 27B-6 format.  Oh and it is countersigned by the correct authorities within the Ranger organization.   <split butt_txt="I'm a bit of a stickler for paperwork" />I agree.  Where would we be if we didn't follow the correct procedures?  I'll go ahead and get this filed appropriately.<split butt_txt="Thank you" />No thank you.  Clearly you talked some sense into those ruffian Rangers.  Maybe they are not such a bunch of savages after all.<split butt_txt="So this might remove a bit of the 'stain' in your relationship?" />*stares at you*  What are you implying?  Do you also have a fondness for pirouetting pie?<split butt_txt="Oh no, not at all." />Good.  Thank you for this apology form.  It will be delivered.  Good day.<split butt_txt="Good bye" />

smelting_smelt_metal_rock_to_plain_metal.title: Helter Smelter
smelting_smelt_metal_rock_to_plain_metal.desc: Fire up a Smelter and turn 100 Chunks of Metal Rock into 20 Plain Metal Ingots without taking a set break.
smelting_smelt_metal_rock_to_plain_metal.offer: A Smelter is the foundation of heavy metal. Which leads me to your next task. Get yourself 100 Chunks of Metal Rock, and fire up a Smelter. You have to smelt all 100 rocks in one go or it doesn't count, so don't stop rockin'.
smelting_smelt_metal_rock_to_plain_metal.completion: Ah, there's nothing like a solid day's work of good honest Smelting. <split butt_txt="I'll say!" /> Your sense of well-being is practically its own reward, wouldn't you say? <split butt_txt="Uh." /> Just messing with you. Here's an actual reward.

requirements.name: 100_metal_smelted
requirements.desc: Smelt 100 metal rocks in one go

smuggle_the_smuggler_part1.title: Smuggle the Smuggler
smuggle_the_smuggler_part1.desc: Go help the wrongfully imprisoned Smuggler.
smuggle_the_smuggler_part1.offer: I've got a job that needs doing. A dangerous job that needs doing.<split butt_txt="Danger? Danger is my middle name." />I thought it was Susan? Anyways, a friend of ours has been wrongfully imprisoned for the transport of contraband and needs to be freed. This will require sneaking into the cell and breaking him out somehow. You up for it?<split butt_txt="Sounds kind of dangerous..." />You can do it, Susan!<split butt_txt="Okay!" />
smuggle_the_smuggler_part1.completion: They got you too? I'm innocent, I tell you! It was all a set up.<split butt_txt="Of course. We're all innocent." />
smuggle_the_smuggler_part1.offerNote: no offer trigger survives; the give Smuggler offers it after a delivery (smuggling-feature.js checks the shovel/ace_of_spades onStarted gate)

smuggle_the_smuggler_part2.title: Smuggle the Smuggler II
smuggle_the_smuggler_part2.desc: Figure out a way to release the Smuggler from prison.
smuggle_the_smuggler_part2.offer: That contraband was planted on me by those agents of the Rook, the Deimaginators. All in a ploy to destroy imagination in the name of "freedom". Puh, I say!<split butt_txt="Well then what say we freedom ourselves out of here? That sounded better in my head." />Good luck finding a way out. I've been looking for a way since I got here.<split butt_txt="You can count on me." />
smuggle_the_smuggler_part2.completion: That's a mighty fine hole you dug yourself there.<split butt_txt="I thought so." />

smuggle_the_smuggler_part3.title: Smuggle the Smuggler III
smuggle_the_smuggler_part3.offer:
Say... that hole looks almost wide enough to fit one glitchen and a half... <split butt_txt="What are you suggesting?" />It'll be a dirty crawl but we'll come out clean on the other side.
<split butt_txt="After you." />

smuggling_basic.title: Warm and Smuggly
smuggling_basic.desc: Deliver the Contraband without getting caught!
smuggling_basic.offer: Deliver the Contraband without getting caught!

snappy_explorer.title: Snappy Explorer
snappy_explorer.desc: Take 3 pictures in 3 different parts of Ur: Aranna, Cauda, and Uralia.
snappy_explorer.offer: You're getting pretty good with this snapshotting thing. But maybe you are! It sure would be nice to have some beautiful pictures of Glitch's many landscapes. Ok, visit and take an inspired photo in Aranna, Cauda, and Uralia. Let's see what you got!
snappy_explorer.completion: They're stunning! <split butt_txt="Thanks!" />Sometimes talent is only half the battle, kid! Here's a little something for the road.

soilappreciation_1.title: Talking ‘bout Soil Appreciation
soilappreciation_1.desc: Learn how to tend patches and dig dirt piles.
soilappreciation_1.offer: Kid, can I ask you a question? Probably not. So I’ll just tell you this: it’s high time you got cozy with a Hoe. And a Shovel. Yes, but in a grounded, urthy kind of way. Ready to appreciate some soil?
soilappreciation_1.completion: You’re on your way now, digster! Here’s a little sumthin’ for your effort.

requirements.name: dig_dirt
requirements.desc: Dig a Dirt Pile or a Patch

soilappreciation_collect_loam.title: Many Shovels Make Something-Something Loam
soilappreciation_collect_loam.desc: Loose 11 Lumps of Loam from Dirt Piles or Patches in 30 minutes (Hint: getting helped by others will help in the loam haul).
soilappreciation_collect_loam.offer: You down with polydiggerous parties, kid? You sure should be. "Many shovels make something-something loam something." Whatever, kid: test it out yourself. Collect 11 Lumps of Loam from Dirt Piles or Patches in under 30 minutes… …And, just to prove my point, try digging with others - it loosens the loam, don'tchaknow.
soilappreciation_collect_loam.completion: See?!? Many shovels make loose loam! Or make loam loose. Or something. Anyway, you loosened your loam and filled your allotted load. Here's a little green for your grubby little thumbs.

requirements.name: dig_loam
requirements.desc: Collect 11 Loam from Dirt Piles and Patches.

soilappreciation_dig_earth.title: Can You Dig It?
soilappreciation_dig_earth.desc: Use your steadfast Shovel to dig 7 Lumps of Earth from Patches or Dirt Piles. Dig deep, little one.
soilappreciation_dig_earth.offer: You look like the kind of Glitch who calls a spade a spade. Don't quibble. Same difference. BUT I'm sure you know the difference between a Patch and a Dirt Pile? Great, so … grab your trusty Shovel and dig 7 Lumps of Earth from Patches or Dirt Piles. I'll check back when you gone done dugged.
soilappreciation_dig_earth.completion: What's that? 7 Lumps of Earth? Already? I suppose a reward is in order. I tell you what: you can keep those lumps. And some extra stuff.

requirements.name: dig_dirt
requirements.desc: Dig 7 Earth from Dirt Piles or Patches.

soilappreciation_get_all_back_yard_trees.title: Seed to Scythe
soilappreciation_get_all_back_yard_trees.desc: Plant 5 Seasoned Beans of any kind in your back yard or home street and raise them to fully grown Trees.
soilappreciation_get_all_back_yard_trees.offer: There's something really special about raising a tree from a Bean. And then harvesting them. Circle of life, kid. You should try it out. Raise five Seasoned Beans of any kind in your back yard or home street to fully-grown Trees, and you'll reap the benefits.
soilappreciation_get_all_back_yard_trees.completion: Everything's all growed up! Well, food isn't the only thing that grows on trees around here. Here's a little token of appreciation. Take that green thumb of yours out for a night on the town.

soilappreciation_help_digging.title: It Takes Two
soilappreciation_help_digging.desc: Get someone to help you while digging a Dirt Pile, three times.
soilappreciation_help_digging.offer: Quite apart from being a crucial element in the soilitary arts, digging is a fabulous joint pursuit. Or "joinsuit". My creativity is wasted on you. Look: Assiduous use of your Shovel reaps great rewards. *Sigh*. Look, say you're digging, you get ONE helpful digger to help dig, you're guaranteed one extra Lump of Earth, or Loam, kid. You dig now? And the more diggers, the better the diggings… But let's keep this simple: find a pal, and with them helping you, go loco on a Dirt Pile, three times. Go, kid!
soilappreciation_help_digging.completion: With a little help from a friend, you've dug deeper into dirt than ever before. For willingness to get your hands dirty, a little thank you from Spriggan.

requirements.name: helped_dig
requirements.desc: Get help from players to dig three Dirt Piles.

soilappreciation_pet_seedlings_to_trees.title: Seedlings BFF
soilappreciation_pet_seedlings_to_trees.desc: Crack your knuckles and administer a gentle but authoritative petting to 7 different Seedlings.
soilappreciation_pet_seedlings_to_trees.offer: All good-hearted people love Trees. Am I right, kid? Yes. I need you to visit seven different Seedlings and administer the finest petting your fingers can muster. Settle down. It's not a hazing. Take good care of them, and there will be a bit of booty for your treasure bag.
soilappreciation_pet_seedlings_to_trees.completion: Those are 7 fine, upstanding Seedlings you've helped along on their journey to Treehood. Here's a little green for your grubby little thumbs.

soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_back_yar.title: Lord of the Beans
soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_back_yar.desc: Plant two Seasoned Beans in your very own yard of your very own house.
soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_back_yar.offer: Hey there, chief. I have a job for you if you're not terribly busy. Good, good. I need you to plant not one but two Seasoned Beans. But not in just any old patch. It has to be in your own little patch of paradise. You'll need to buy a house if you don't own one already. Okay?
soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_back_yar.completion: I spy, with my wee eyes, two Seasoned Beans planted snug in the ground. Bravo. Here's a little something to plant in your pocketses.

soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_hubs.title: The Unbearable Lightness of Bean
soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_hubs.desc: Plant at least one Seasoned Bean (the kind that can grow there) in three different regions.
soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_hubs.offer: Let me plant an idea in that fertile little mind of yours. Nature can handle itself, but it never hurts to give it a hand sometimes, pollination-wise. You in? Good stuff. In the great tradition of itinerant gardeners and giant bees, I want you to go forth, to three different regions, and plant a Seasoned Bean in each… Bearing in mind, of course, that you can only plant certain kinds of beans in each region, my friend. Remember: Different beans for different regions. Toodles!
soilappreciation_plant_beans_in_hubs.completion: You've been around the world and you-you-you-you, you have planted trees and I don't know why, but I just feel like giving you a special little something-something. Here you are, little honeybee.

requirements.name: hub_plant_beans
requirements.desc: Plant a Seasoned Bean in each of three different regions.

soilappreciation_tend_patch_get_drop.title: Patch Working
soilappreciation_tend_patch_get_drop.desc: Tend as many Patches as you can until you get a super-fun secret happy bonus prize.
soilappreciation_tend_patch_get_drop.offer: So, kid. By now you're on to the fact that, sometimes, when you tend a Patch, you find little surprises. Now that you've upped your ante in the Soil Appreciation arts, you'll find these little surprises have upped their ante, too. Keep tending, and see what pops up.
soilappreciation_tend_patch_get_drop.completion: A Music Block! Score! I told you that tending all those patches would pay off. Here's another payoff, just to show you that perseverance isn't its only own reward.

soilappreciation_tend_patches.title: Dig the earth and tend the soil
soilappreciation_tend_patches.desc: Use your trusty Hoe to tend 5 weedy Patches. Watch your toes. Hoes are sharp!
soilappreciation_tend_patches.offer: Hoeing offers a lot of benefits. Well, on top of being a necessary part of the patch-clearing process, it's also a great workout for that weird little organ you have that moves that squishy stuff around your body. Is that what you call that thing? And did I mention that sometimes, while hoeing, you can find some pretty keen loot hiding in the weeds? Get yourself a Hoe and tend 5 weedy Patches. I'll check back when you're done.
soilappreciation_tend_patches.completion: Hoetastic! Good job on tending those patches. The Giants thank you. And they also asked me to give you a bunch of little bonus-y things.
