space_race.title: Space Race
space_race.desc: Race through space to be the first past the post.
space_race.offer: Race through space to be the first past the post.

sparkly_of_interest_1.title: Well, I Neva!
sparkly_of_interest_1.desc: Find your way in to Neva Neva.
sparkly_of_interest_1.offer: So, I've heard you're quick with a pick... And fleet on your feet... One to ask when you have a task I've got a job for you, if you're up to it, but first we need a little test. Find your way through the locks in to Neva Neva and I'll fill you in there.
sparkly_of_interest_1.completion: Nice work on making it in. A determined individual like you is just what I need.

sparkly_of_interest_2.title: Sparkly of Interest
sparkly_of_interest_2.offer: You might be wondering why I've summoned you here today. <split butt_txt="That sounds omnious." />Relax, twitchy. It's all legit. <split butt_txt="I've got my lawyer on speed dial..." />I've been studying the differences between sparkly deposits in Ur and Neva Neva has one of the highest concentrations. I need a sample of the mineral but I seem to lack the ability to mine, which is where you come in. <split butt_txt="Go, Team Appendages!" />Mine and grind me up a batch of sparkly and I'll make it worth your while.
sparkly_of_interest_2.completion: Nice work, that's a fine sample of sparkly, indeed. <split butt_txt="It's some of my best work." /> Certainly a good start to my research.

requirements.name: mine_100_sparkly_while_in_neva_neva
requirements.desc: Mine 100 chunks of sparkly while in Neva Neva

sparkly_of_interest_3.title: A Blissful Trip
sparkly_of_interest_3.desc: Find your way in to Ajaya Bliss
sparkly_of_interest_3.offer: Think you're up for another trip? There's whispers of another deposit of the shiny stuff in Illmenske, if the bubble trees aren't lying. Head on over to the depths and see if you can find your way in to a place called Ajaya Bliss.
sparkly_of_interest_3.completion: You did it, kid. Great work. Bet you can't guess what I'm going to ask you to do next. <split butt_txt="I bet I can..." />Hush, you. Here's a small something for the walk.

sparkly_of_interest_4.title: Another Simple Sample
sparkly_of_interest_4.offer: I need another sample of this shiny stuff so I can compare it with the ones taken from Neva Neva. <split butt_txt="I'm now rethinking this whole arms thing..." /> Just work through the pain, for science! ...And rewards.
sparkly_of_interest_4.completion: Another fine specimen from the sample master!  <split butt_txt="I think I sprained my wrist!" /> Just walk it off. Here's a little something to ease the pain. I'm off to study the data.

requirements.name: mine_100_sparkly_in_ajaya_bliss
requirements.desc: Mine 100 chunks of sparkly while in Ajaya Bliss

requirements.name: grind_100_chunks_of_sparkly_in_ajaya_bliss
requirements.desc: Grind 100 chunks of sparkly while in Ajaya Bliss

spice_must_flow.title: The Spice Must Flow
spice_must_flow.desc: Get yourself to West/East Spice to harvest 19 Allspice for the Street Spirits.
spice_must_flow.offer: Hey, {pc_label}, wanna know how I float up in the air like this?<split butt_txt="Yeah, sure" />Allspice... Makes us sooooo higgghhhhh.<split butt_txt="OK" />True story. Anyway, can you get me some? I'm feeling kinda low.<split butt_txt="I don't see why not" />Great, thanks. The only spice for me comes from East/West Spice in Ix. I need 19 of them, and don't forget to get some for yourself!
spice_must_flow.completion: Yesssssss. That's the stuff, thanks! I hope you didn't forget to pick up some for yourself. Here's something you might be able to use it with.

spicemilling_transform_spices.title: Spice is the Variety of Life
spicemilling_transform_spices.desc: Using a Spice Mill, turn ordinary Allspice into 2 each of Ginger, Curry, Mustard and Black Pepper.
spicemilling_transform_spices.offer: Spices are the variety of life, chum. And you look like you're ready for a little variety. Don't fight it. We're going to start small. Get yourself a Spice Mill and some Allspice. Then use the Spice Mill to create 2 each of Ginger, Curry, Mustard and Black Pepper. And then I'll tell you what. Yes?
spicemilling_transform_spices.completion: That's some solid Spice Milling, friend. And now look at all the Spices you've created. Use them as ingredients in foods and drinks. Buy a Spice Rack for storing them. Use your Spice Mill to make even more Spices! The question isn't what can you do with Spices. The question is what can't you do with them!

spread_garlic_love.title: Spread the Garlic Love
spread_garlic_love.desc: Kiss 5 different players while under the effects of eating Garlic. In order to kiss people, you'll need to buy some Lips from any Street Spirit who sells Hardware. You'll also need an Emotional Bear, but you should already have one of those. Garlic can be bought from any Street Spirit who sells Groceries or Produce.
spread_garlic_love.offer: You want to know a funny thing about garlic, kid? Everyone always says they hate garlic breath, but secretly they love it. Absotively. You know what you should do? Go eat some Garlic and kiss 5 other players. Test my theory. Come on. I'm right about this. I feel it in my sediment. And even if I'm wrong, it's still funny, right? So go for it. I'll be waiting here and thinking up a nice little reward for you.
spread_garlic_love.completion: Was I right? Did they love those garlicky kisses? <split butt_txt="Well..." /> Feh. Who cares! Nice working with you, kid.

stale_but_necessary.title: Being Watched
stale_but_necessary.desc: You drank water from a questionable source and you don't look well. You need to ride it out.
stale_but_necessary.offer: Umm, You don't look so good.<split butt_txt="I don’t feel so good." />Yeah, you look really, well … plain, boring, without character.<split butt_txt="I think it’s something I drank." />Ah, maybe you should nap for a bit then?
stale_but_necessary.completion: Ahh, that's better! You look like your normal "interesting" self again.<split butt_txt="What happened?!" />You passed out. Hard. Rolled around in your sleep, embarrassed yourself a bit, then woke up.<split butt_txt="You were watching?" />Oh ho, yes. But, here's something that will make you feel better.
stale_but_necessary.offerNote: item_use cup_of_water trigger; offered after Legalize It

star_sprint.title: Star Sprint
star_sprint.desc: Want to touch the stars? You have to get there first. Race! To the top!
star_sprint.offer: Want to touch the stars? You have to get there first. Race! To the top!

teleportation_make_and_hand_out_tp_scrip.title: The World Through Ur Eyes
teleportation_make_and_hand_out_tp_scrip.desc: Create three Teleportation Scripts for some of your favourite places in the world, and distribute them among strangers.
teleportation_make_and_hand_out_tp_scrip.offer: Close your eyes, little Glitchling. Have you closed them? They look like they're open. Close your inner eyes. The eyes beyond your Glitchly eyes. Are they closed? How can you still hear me? Look, just forget the eye thing. Just imagine your favourite places in all of Ur. Are you doing that? Now, wouldn't it be nice to share those places with others? Yes. Yes it would. So do it! With your newfound skill, some Paper and a Quill, write three Teleportation Scripts to your favourite places in Ur, and hand them out to three different people. Share your love of the land, y'hear?
teleportation_make_and_hand_out_tp_scrip.completion: I say "favourite places in Ur", and you choose… Woah. Those? Really?!? <split butt_txt="What!?…" /> Don't get me wrong they're, y'know, lovely. Just. Um. Here! Here's a little reward - use it wisely. Have you thought about travel?

teleportation_rescue_pig.title: Ilmenskie Jones and the Sealed Cavern
teleportation_rescue_pig.desc: Use your 'Teleport via Map' ability to investigate the disappearance of famed explorer Ilmenskie Jones, last seen in Axis Denyde.
teleportation_rescue_pig.offer: Kid, I can only assume you’ve heard of Ilmenskie Jones.Seriously? Ilmenskie Jones and the Marauders of the Lost Bean? Ilmenskie Jones and the Sparkly Femur? Ringing any bells?OK, wow. Well, he’s only the most famous adventurer in all of Ur. And he’s a senior lecturer in porkthropology at Porcine University. In short, he’s dreamy.Well he’s heard of you. He left a note in his office when he set off to explore the infamous Sealed Cavern of Axis Denyde. "If you don’t hear from me within a week," it read, "please notify whats-their-name. You know, the pedantic one" He could only have meant you, sure as eggs is eggs. See?!? Clearly you. So using your newly acquired powers of Teleportation IV, perhaps you could hop right on over to him and help him out? Problem is, it being a sealed cavern, the entrance is blocked off. So you'll need to locate Axis Denyde in Pollokoo on the map, and then teleport in that way. Would you mind checking in to see what’s taking him so long?
teleportation_rescue_pig.completion: What a guy, huh, kid?<split butt_txt="He seemed kind of…" />Amazing? I know. Man, if I could teleport using the map, like him or, well, like you? Imagine the jinks I could get up to… <split butt_txt="I can take you with me…" />Sweet thought, kid. Let's do that: whenever the mood takes you - well, a few times a day for free, and more with tokens - just open the map, choose a street to teleport to, and click! We'll be off! Exploring! That's cheered me up. Let me do the same for you (as if meeting Ilmenskie Jones wasn’t already reward enough).

requirements.name: rescue_pig
requirements.desc: Rescue Ilmenskie Jones from certain peril

teleportation_teleport_between_zones.title: Beam You Up
teleportation_teleport_between_zones.desc: Click on Teleport in the imagination menu to help you create a landing point anywhere in Tamila, and then jump to it from anywhere in Shimla Mirch. It's practically pain-free and almost foolproof.
teleportation_teleport_between_zones.offer: So you've chosen to embrace the fine art of Teleportation. Exactly. You've got better things to do with those legs. Just to give you a little teleportational jump start, I'm going to offer you a little something special if you can figure out how to get yourself from, oh, let's say Shimla Mirch, over to Tamila. I'll even give you a little hint. Go find a nice spot somewhere in Tamila. When you get there, click on me and create a new landing point. After that, you're on your own.
teleportation_teleport_between_zones.completion: Nice work. The first Teleportation jump is always the toughest. But look at you! You re-assembled almost perfectly. <split butt_txt="Yay!" /> Now that you've figured out the basics, keep practicing. You can change your landing point any time you want. And in the meantime, enjoy this little gift.

teleportation_teleport_in_time_period.title: Fear of Flying
teleportation_teleport_in_time_period.offer: Hey! What's with the face? Oh… you've heard the rumours and you're worried about the dangers of speed teleportation. That's it, right? Oh, you've not heard the rumours? Oh. Um. Well, regardless, Fly, you've nothing to worry about. Just to prove it, try teleporting five times in 30 minutes. Sure, you might experience some side effects of teleportation, but nothing TOO weird…
teleportation_teleport_in_time_period.completion: Look! Here you are! And let me just check. Two arms… yup. Legs… two, yup. Livers… all of them… yup. Nose? Well, as long as you're happy that's the one you came in with… <split butt_txt="Hey! What are you…" /> Good job, Fly. You deserve a little boost after all that.

teleportation_teleport_to_region.title: To Xalanga, And Beyond
teleportation_teleport_to_region.desc: Set a teleportation point in Xalanga, then teleport there from any other region. (Hint: Access your Teleport ability through the 'iMG' menu)
teleportation_teleport_to_region.offer: So you've chosen to embrace the fine art of Teleportation. Exactly. You've got better things to do with those legs. Just to give you a little teleportational jump start, I'm going to offer you a little something special if you can figure out how to teleport yourself from anywhere in the world to the rich hunting grounds of Xalanga. I'll even give you a little hint. Go find a nice spot somewhere in Xalanga. When you get there, click on the 'iMG' menu, choose Teleport and create a new landing point. After that, you're on your own.
teleportation_teleport_to_region.completion: Surprise! You're back in Xalanga! <split butt_txt="That wasn't much of a surprise." /> No, well, fair enough. Still, it's useful to remember that you can come back any time. These desert regions are a hotbed of treasure huntingness, you know. <split butt_txt="Oh they are, are they?" /> They are! But to save you the trouble for now, here's a little something from my back pocket. Or which would be, if I had one…

teleportation_teleport_with_followers.title: Three's a Cloud
teleportation_teleport_with_followers.desc: Teleport with three Glitches (or more) in tow.
teleportation_teleport_with_followers.offer: You know what's hot? <split butt_txt="Me?" />*Sigh*. Apart from you. Think about it: that whoosh you get when you suddenly feel the dispersed particles of three or more Glitches rush past your head. You know what that is, kid? Cloud commuting. <split butt_txt="Do you mean…" /> I mean what I say, peanut. Commuting from one place to the other as a group, in a dispersed cloud of teleported particles: Cloud Commuting! <split butt_txt="I'm in! What's the plan?" /> That's the spirit. Gather three or more Glitches, get them to follow you and, when you're sure they're all following, whisk them away by teleportation. Where? Doesn't matter. Just as long as you zap there.
teleportation_teleport_with_followers.completion: BAM! Quick, easy, low in energy and high in efficiency, no? <split butt_txt="No. I mean yes." />  And you all got here in one piece! One piece each, I mean! And you didn't even swap any pieces along the way. <split butt_txt="You sound surprised." /> Nooooooooo. Well, first time for everything, I guess. Well, to celebrate your survival… I mean, triumph… here's a little something.

tend_to_your_community.title: Tend to Your Community
tend_to_your_community.desc: Visit the Chakra Phool Herb Gardens, in Chakra Phool. Plant 5 Yellow Crumb Flower Seeds and 5 Silvertongue Seeds. Then, harvest 5 herbs of any type, and donate them to the shrine at Pahsmeq Diggs in Kajuu.
tend_to_your_community.offer: Well, shucks. It looks like you're getting pretty good at planting and harvesting herbs. But, there's something to be said for "giving back". Go to Chakra Phool Herb Gardens, in Chakra Phool and Plant 5 Yellow Crumb Flower Seeds and 5 Silvertongue Seeds. Then, harvest 5 herbs of any type and donate them to the shrine at Pahsmeq Diggs in Kajuu.
tend_to_your_community.completion: Hey, why so pale? You look like you've seen a Giant! <split butt_txt="I did, I did!" />Uh huh. Suuuure you did.<split butt_txt="I swear!" /> Giant sightings aside, you've done a good thing for your community. Take pride!

time_warp.title: Time Warp
time_warp.desc: Be the first to the end of the time warp to win the race.
time_warp.offer: Be the first to the end of the time warp to win the race.

tincturing_make_tinctures.title: Tincture Tailor
tincturing_make_tinctures.desc: Use a Tincturing Kit and your Tincturing skill to create all seven Tinctures in an act of Top Tincturous Tincturery. And ponder the word 'tincture', while you're at it. Tincture. Tincture. Tincture.
tincturing_make_tinctures.offer: Ah, a student of the Tincturing arts, are you? Fancy! Well, mastering tincture theory is one thing, putting it into practice is quite another. Sure it is, kid. You'll need a Tincturing Kit, for one thing. A Tincturing Kit, the ability to function with scorched nasal hairs, a super-glitchean gag reflex and… Never mind. Let's start with the Tincturing Kit. Get one, have a go at creating the seven essential essences, and then we'll talk again.
tincturing_make_tinctures.completion: Nice work! How are those nasal hairs? <split butt_txt="Fine. I think?" /> If you can't hear'em screaming, you've mastered that Tincturing Kit faster than I ever thought possible.<split butt_txt="Well, I don't like to brag. But yes. I'm awesome." /> You are. And you should try those tinctures. But meanwhile, for your dedication to the art of the tinct, here's a little bump…

requirements.name: r309
requirements.desc: Make an Essence of Yellow Crumb

tinkering_craft_medium_tools.title: Magnanimous Maker
tinkering_craft_medium_tools.desc: The Giants have needs, and right now they need a Cocktail Shaker and an Awesome Pot. Use your Tinkertool to craft one of each, then donate each to the Shrines of the patron Giants of Cocktail Crafting and Master Cheffery.
tinkering_craft_medium_tools.offer: Hey, kid. Now that you're a hotshot with the ol' Tinkertool, feel like crafting yourself up a shiny chrome-plated Cocktail Shaker? That's the attitude, kid. When you're done, donate it to the patron Giant of Cocktail Crafting. And when you're done with that, do the same thing, but with Master Cheffery.
tinkering_craft_medium_tools.completion: Well done, kid. Making a Cocktail Shaker and an Awesome Pot is hard. And letting them go is even harder. <split butt_txt="Give till it hurts. My motto." /> You're a modern-day hero. Here's the usual remuneration, plus a little something extra. Because I like you.

tinkering_craft_simple_tools.title: Gettin' Crafty
tinkering_craft_simple_tools.desc: Use your trusty Tinkertool, to craft up a Frying Pan, a Hatchet, and a Watering Can. Then sell them to the right vendors to replenish their stock.
tinkering_craft_simple_tools.offer: There's a tool shortage throughout the lands. We need you to use your Tinkertool to tinker up a Frying Pan, a Hatchet, and a Watering Can, and then sell them to the right vendors to replenish their stock. Now, if I gave you all the answers, this wouldn't be much of a quest, would it?
tinkering_craft_simple_tools.completion: Frying Pan, check. Hatchet, check. Watering Can, check. You're a credit to the noble field of Tinkering. <split butt_txt="Credit? I prefer cash." /> Not quite what I meant, my friend, but on that note, here's the usual something-something for your efforts.

tinkering_repair_even_more_tools.title: Master Tinkerer
tinkering_repair_even_more_tools.desc: Use your handy-dandy Tinkertool to up and fix 11 different kinds of broken tools. (This is the kind of job you can do for your friends. Or even for friendly strangers.)
tinkering_repair_even_more_tools.offer: Feeling dangerous? Perfect, because there is nothing dangerous about fixing 11 different kinds of tools. Difficult, yes. But the rewards... wow. No. Not at all. I was thinking about something else for a second. I guess I said wow without thinking. Don't worry, though. You'll do okay.
tinkering_repair_even_more_tools.completion: I knew you had it in you to fix 11 different tools! Well, I suspected you did anyways. <split butt_txt="I never stopped believing in me." /> While this sort of self-reliance is a virtue unto itself, it never hurts to get a little something for all that elbow grease you had to burn through. And here it is.

tinkering_repair_for_time_period.title: Tinker Well
tinkering_repair_for_time_period.desc: Use a trusty Tinkertool to sustain a 15-second repair on a broken tool. (Hint: You can break a tool yourself through excessive use, or you can get a broken tool from a friend.)
tinkering_repair_for_time_period.offer: Let me drop a little hard-boiled philosophy on you, kid. Sometimes in life, things break. You can cry about it. Or you can cry about it and then fix it. Of course you do. Now get a Tinkertool, then find a broken tool and Repair the daylights out of it.
tinkering_repair_for_time_period.completion: See? Good as new. Waste not, want not. A currant saved is a currant-- <split butt_txt="It sure is." />Grrr. I don't care for interruptions! But I'm still going to give you your reward. This time.

tinkering_repair_more_tools.title: Fixit Friend
tinkering_repair_more_tools.desc: You've fixed up 3 different tools. You've even fixed up a Tinkertool. But are you ready to fix 7 different kinds of tools? Do you even know 7 different kinds of tools?
tinkering_repair_more_tools.offer: You know one of the best ways to make friends and influence people? Close! Fix their stuff. Then get out there with your Tinkertool and fix 7 up broken tools for fun AND profit.
tinkering_repair_more_tools.completion: Those 7 broken tools are well and truly fixed. Just talking to you makes me feel productive, kid. Just for that, I think it's fair to say you've earned yourself a 7-tool-fixin'-sized perk.

tinkering_repair_tinkertool.title: Tinker with Your Tool(s)
tinkering_repair_tinkertool.desc: Ever notice that when you use a Tinkertool to repair itself, you can never quite get it back to 100%? There is a way though … and I need you to repair a Tinkertool all the way back to 100% capacity. Hint: you might want to borrow a second tool from a friend, and use drag-and-drop!
tinkering_repair_tinkertool.offer: So, you use your Tinkertool to fix your broken tools, but then what do you use to fix a broken Tinkertool? You're smarter than you look, friend. Oops. I meant to say EVEN smarter. Moving right along... ready to start a-tinkering?
tinkering_repair_tinkertool.completion: So now that you've got two good Tinkertools, what are you going to do with them? <split butt_txt="I dunno. Got any suggestions?" /> Not my department, kid. My job is to give you this little bonus and then make like a mineral and flake.

requirements.name: tinkertool_repaired
requirements.desc: Repair your Tinkertool with another Tinkertool

tinkering_repair_tools.title: Third Time Really Is the Charm
tinkering_repair_tools.desc: Use your Tinkertool to fix three different tools up to 100%.
tinkering_repair_tools.offer: It's a shame to see broken tools just laying there, all useless-like. What they need is a hero. Well, then, whip that Tinkertool out of your tights and get to work.
tinkering_repair_tools.completion: Say, when did you get the new tools? <split butt_txt="They're not new. I fixed em!" /> I knew that. Your greasy paw prints are all over them. I wanted you to feel good about yourself. <split butt_txt="Thanks?" /> Look, I'm not good at this sort of thing. So here. Just take this little bonus, and let's leave this awkwardness behind us.

tower_defense.title: Tower Defense
tower_defense.desc: Call down a rook attack on your Tower and defend it with a little help from your friends.
tower_defense.offer: Nice Tower you've got going there. It'd be a shame if something were to... happen to it.Oh, you know: war, pestilence, Rook Attacks... that sort of thing.O RLY? Well then, if you're ready, I think I can arrange it. You're going to need some assistance though. Let me know when you're ready.
tower_defense.completion: Well, you managed to handle that pathetic little Rook Attack. [slow clap].<split butt_txt="I detect sarcasm." />You're an incisive one, aren't you. Well, here's your rewards. Maybe next time it'll be harder.

tower_quest.title: Gwendolyn's Task
tower_quest.offer: Hear me. I am Gwendolyn, disciple of Cosma, daughter of Egeria, drowned as I lived in the waters of Grendaline’s Rising. I have watched the giants battle and build, the worlds consume each other, imaginations turned inside out, and generations disappear beneath the layers. So long we searched for Cosma – lying in the gutter, gazing at the stars, watching the wind, waiting for her instruction … … so long we lay, so long we gazed, we never noticed the coming of the age of Grendaline, lapping at our heels, washing over our faces. Learn from our mistakes, I beg you. You must not lose yourself to the world, but find yourself within it. You must learn a measure of mastery over your own mind. If you are ready, I will send you on a journey where you can learn to avoid the fate of my people. Are you ready?
tower_quest.offerNote: The Ghost of Gwendolyn offers it in Room 23 (behind Corridor Five's key 5 door); Greeterbot Sentry G-42's level 12 gate stands before her

tower_quest_part2.title: Gwendolyn's Task II
tower_quest_part2.completion: See? Zzybzfrx told you it be cool, and cool it is. I. Zzybzfrx. No one knows where I am really from, or who I am for certain. But know this: you have reached the apex of your brain. You’ve been to paradise. And you’ve also been to you. I told you it was cool, right?

tower_quest_part3.title: Gwendolyn's Task III
tower_quest_part3.offer:
Damn right. Never say Zzybzfrx doesn’t take you where the cool kids go. One more challenge lies before you. Complete it, and I will have no problem awarding you a Measure of Self-Mastery. You can do it?
<split butt_txt="I can do it." />
Then let’s do it.
tower_quest_part3.completion: This is not the end. You have completed today’s challenge, and must be on your way, but your self-knowledge is only begun. You may not see Zzybzfrx, that friendly Figment, but he will be there. I too am always here, somewhere. Remember me, and heed my warning – do not follow the ways of those who have gone before. You will make your own path. As for me, I will return one day, to tell you of my beautiful, lost-so-long, Butterfly-Bone Hair Clip. For now, take my warnings, and my blessing. And this: a token of our esteem.

tower_quest_part3repeat.title: Gwendolyn's Task III
tower_quest_part3repeat.offer:
Damn right. Never say Zzybzfrx doesn’t take you where the cool kids go. One more challenge lies before you. Complete it, and I will have no problem reaffirming your Measure of Self-Mastery. You can do it?
<split butt_txt="I can do it." />
Then let’s do it.
tower_quest_part3repeat.completion: This is not the end. You have completed the journey again, and must be on your way, but your self-knowledge is only begun. You may not see Zzybzfrx, that friendly Figment, but he will be there. I too am always here, somewhere. Remember me, and heed my warning – do not follow the ways of those who have gone before. You will make your own path. As for me, I will return one day, to tell you of my beautiful, lost-so-long, Butterfly-Bone Hair Clip. For now, take my warnings, and my blessing. And this: a token of our esteem.

transcendentalradiation_radiate_to_five_.title: Sharing the Oneness
transcendentalradiation_radiate_to_five_.desc: Use your Focusing Orb to Radiate Transcendence at 5 lucky passersby at the same time. They'll thank you later.
transcendentalradiation_radiate_to_five_.offer: You're down with the meditation, aren't you, kid? Good, good. Now you're ready to bring other people into the oneness. Don't be greedy. It's a big oneness. Use your Focusing Orb to radiate your inwardness in an outward direction to 5 different players. Did I mention that all 5 players have to receive your radiation at the exact same time? That's the spirit. Moist, chewy transcendental cake.
transcendentalradiation_radiate_to_five_.completion: Nice work, bub. You radiated the bejeebus out of those folks. <split butt_txt="Their chakras will never be the same." /> And what did I tell you? Was that a big oneness, or what? <split butt_txt="Roomy, but still cozy." />Like a woolly sweater for your soul. Om, chum.

treasure_map_1.title: A Hidden Treasure
treasure_map_1.desc: The map is pretty hard to read, but it seems to depict a small, wooded island in the sea. On the north-east corner of the island, down a dead-end street, is a big, red, X.
treasure_map_1.offer: This is clearly a pirate's treasure map, big red X and all. Following it will almost certainly net you a reward.

tutorial_reinforcement.title: A Little Tutorial Reinforcement
tutorial_reinforcement.desc: As a wise giant once said, repetition breeds love: go and find a Pig to pet (then pet it), a Tree to water (then water it) and mark a destination on the Map, and go to it.
tutorial_reinforcement.offer: As a wise giant once said, repetition breeds love: go and find a Pig to pet (then pet it), a Tree to water (then water it) and mark a destination on the Map, and go to it.
tutorial_reinforcement.completion: Well done with the Pig-petting, Tree-watering and Path-finding. You have proven that you are a great and noble instruction follower. This will prove a valuable skill.<split butt_txt="Hmpf." /> Tut. The world thanks you for your efforts. Here's a lil something something for your trouble.

ultimate_smoothie_1.title: The Ultimate Smoothie
ultimate_smoothie_1.desc: We'll need to start simple - bring me some milk, plums and strawberries.
ultimate_smoothie_1.offer: Listen up, I have an idea. We're going to make the best drink you can imagine. You in?
ultimate_smoothie_1.completion: Good job. Let me just whisk these up and...

ultimate_smoothie_2.title: The Ultimate Smoothie, part 2
ultimate_smoothie_2.desc: You'll need to find some more ingredients. A little gravy, infused with a home-made pickle. This drink is going to blow your socks off.
ultimate_smoothie_2.offer: Something's not quite right - it's going to need a little something something.
ultimate_smoothie_2.completion: Perfect! A Gravy-Pickle infusion is just what's called for.

ultimate_smoothie_3.title: The Ultimate Smoothie, part 3
ultimate_smoothie_3.desc: It needs a little sweetening. Grab these last ingredients, honey and camphor, and we'll be golden.
ultimate_smoothie_3.offer: Tasty! But still not quite there. I think I know what it's missing.
ultimate_smoothie_3.completion:
BAM! Mix in the Camphor and it'll be perfect...
<split butt_txt="Ok" />
Urgh. This is actually pretty gross. I'll give you some currants if you keep quiet and pretend this never happened.

umbra_black_white.title: Umbrian Black and White
umbra_black_white.desc: Get monochromatic in Umbra by making one vial White Gas, one piece of Licorice, and one mounds Black Pepper.
umbra_black_white.offer: Is it Black? Or is it White? Does it matter? Why not both?! Make one vial of White Gas, one piece of Licorice, and one mound Black Pepper.
umbra_black_white.completion: Awesome! You are color blind! (In a good way!)

vendor_ping_pong_part1.title: Meet the Merchants
vendor_ping_pong_part1.desc: Visit the Gardening Vendor in Northwest Passage. He has some work for you.
vendor_ping_pong_part1.offer: Hi! I'm your pet rock. I'll be your guide to this brand new world. If you're ready to get started, let's go. OK, great. Here's the first thing you should do: head over to the Gardening Vendor in Northwest Passage. He has some work for you. Click on your map over there in the top right corner to locate him.
vendor_ping_pong_part1.completion: Oh, hello! I've been expecting you. Maybe you can help me out...

offerTriggers.why: offer is the pet rock speaking; end_npcs npc_gardening_vendor

vendor_ping_pong_part2.title: Meet the Merchants
vendor_ping_pong_part2.desc:
Deliver 1 pack of tomato seeds, 1 pack of onion seeds, a hoe, and a watering can to the Tool Vendor on Ti Street in Groddle.

Don't forget to buy these items from the Gardening Vendor before you head off.
vendor_ping_pong_part2.offer: I have a friend who sells tools over in Groddle, on Ti Street. He's been thinking of growing a garden, but he needs some seeds. He has a terrible green thumb, so he needs my help. Can you take him 1 pack of tomato seeds, 1 pack of onion seeds, a hoe, and a watering can? You'll have to buy these items from me first. The tool vendor will pay you back. You can count on him. He may have a black thumb, but he's chock full of scruples.
vendor_ping_pong_part2.completion: Thank you so much! I can't wait to get started on my garden.<split butt_txt="Oh. Uh. Good luck?" />  Don't believe anything the Gardening Vendor tells you. He's just jealous that my pumpkin took first prize in the Groddle Forest Harvest Fair.<split butt_txt="Wow. Congratulations." />  Here's your money, plus a little something extra for your trouble.

offerTriggers.why: offer is the Gardening Tools Vendor speaking

vendor_ping_pong_part3.title: Meet the Merchants
vendor_ping_pong_part3.desc:
Deliver 3 tubes of butterfly lotion to the Cooking Vendor who works in the Thicket in Groddle Forest.

Don't forget to buy the lotion before you set off.
vendor_ping_pong_part3.offer: You've been such a great help so far. Are you up for another errand? There's a fellow who sells hard-to-come-by cooking ingredients. He lives in the Thicket here in Groddle Forest. He has a thing for butterfly lotion. I don't know if he eats it or uses it on himself or what. It's not my place to judge, so can you bring him 3 tubes of butterfly lotion? I try. You can buy the lotion from me. The Cooking Vendor in the Thicket will pay you back. He's good for it. Despite his bizarre penchants, he's quite trustworthy.
vendor_ping_pong_part3.completion: My lotion! Excellent. My precious butterfly will be so happy. He's been complaining about my calluses.<split butt_txt="Er..." /> What has the Tool Vendor been telling you? Oh, never mind. Besides, you wouldn't believe what that guy's into.

offerTriggers.why: offer is the Gardening Tools Vendor speaking

vendor_ping_pong_part4.title: Meet the Merchants
vendor_ping_pong_part4.desc:
Deliver 6 beers and 1 hooch to Uncle Friendly, the food vendor. You can find him in his store on Guillermo Gamera Way in Ix.

Tip: you'll need to find the Great Hole to Ix to make your way there.

Don't forget to buy the booze before you set off.
vendor_ping_pong_part4.offer: My friend Uncle Friendly, the Food Vendor, gave me a big feast the other night and I want to pay him back. He really likes his drinks, so can you bring him 6 beers and 1 hooch? Great. He lives on Guillermo Gamera Way in Ix. Make sure not to drink the hooch, though. It has quite the kick! You can buy these items from me before you leave. Uncle Friendly will pay you back. He's pretty reliable... before he gets into the drinks.
vendor_ping_pong_part4.completion: Thannnks very mush. I've been runnin low on my drinksss. *hickup* Here iz somes of my speshall stuffs for speshall peeples.<split butt_txt="Oh, thanks!" /> Off with youse now. Uncle Friendly needz to be alonez for a spell.

offerTriggers.why: offer is the Gardening Tools Vendor speaking

water_neighbor_garden.title: Give your neighbors a cup of water.
water_neighbor_garden.desc: Surprise a friend by watering their gardens for them!
water_neighbor_garden.offer: Your neighbor's plants sure are looking thirsty. Looks like they forgot to water them! A nice generous sprinkle sure would be a nice surprise for your neighbor. Water 5 gardens that belong to any neighbor(s) and give them a bit of H20 lovin'!
water_neighbor_garden.completion: Those plants are looking a lot happier! It's good to spread the love and water. I raise my glass of water to you, kid.

watering_time.title: Super Soaker
watering_time.desc: It's hot out there. Grab your trusty watering can and soak 5 different players. They'll thank you later.
watering_time.offer: Hey, kid. It's hot out there. <split butt_txt="Sure is." />Grab your watering can and soak 5 different players. Trust me, they'll thank you for it.
watering_time.completion: You soaked 'em good, kid. But soaking isn't its own reward. You deserve a little something extra. Here you go. <split butt_txt="Thank you!" />Don't mention it. And remember: you can soak as many people as you wish. That can is bottomless for a reason.

where_the_blue_grew.title: Operation: Grow
where_the_blue_grew.desc: Solve the puzzle to brighten up the gloomy, forgotten bog fields. I bet Mab left a hint somewhere to help you out.
where_the_blue_grew.offer: So dark. <split butt_txt="Say whaaa?" /> The forgotten bog fields have always been a little glum, but this place is the glum-iest! <split butt_txt="Which place?" />  An out-of-the-way place that apparently only Mab can remember. <split butt_txt="I see." /> Be a pal and see if you can brighten up the landscape a bit?
where_the_blue_grew.completion: Wow, you're smarter than you look! <split butt_txt="Is that a compliment?" /> I mean that in a good way, champ. <split butt_txt="Okay then." />  Yeah, here’s a complementary reward even.
where_the_blue_grew.offerNote: quests_offer ignores prerequisites: any of the four Firebog completist badges offers it

wierd_n_wild.title: Weird n' Wild
wierd_n_wild.desc: Snap pictures of a Fox, a Sloth, and an AFLC Frog.
wierd_n_wild.offer: You're getting pretty handy with this snapshotting exploration stuff. Wanna explore some of the wilder life in Ur? Great. This time you will need to take 3 snaps - one of a Fox, another of a Sloth, and finally, one of an AFLC Frog. Cool? Get snappin!

winter_walk.title: Winter Walk
winter_walk.offer: Feel that cool breeze? It's reminiscent of something … <split butt_txt="What?" /> A cold, snow-covered place — crisp air and the quiet peace of each year's night. <split butt_txt="Tell me more!" /> I believe there's something special about the icicles … but perhaps you would like to see it for yourself?
winter_walk.completion: Brrr! Did you really have to bring the chill back with you? Oh, I think you dropped this on your way back.

winter_walk_part2.title: Winter Walk
winter_walk_part2.completion: Hope it was a breath of fresh air.

you_croaked.title: You Croaked
you_croaked.desc: Squish 11 bunches of hellish grapes to get yourself out of this hellish purgatory and back to the real world.
you_croaked.offer: Uh oh. You croaked! Bummer! And right when you were going to win the game, too.Fortunately, this condition is not permanent. Everyone really likes their Wine of the Dead, so they'll resurrect you if you help them make some more.Just find some hellish grapes on the ground in here and give them some good squashing. Keep going until you get out!
you_croaked.completion: You did it, but squishing grapes is tiring work and now you're 'pooped'. You can only croak once a day, but you'll need to get your energy back up to start feeling better. Run out of energy while pooped and you'll end up 'super-pooped', and that's really no fun!

zero_mood.title: Tickle Me Emo
zero_mood.desc: Break free from your angsty funk and embrace 33 different players in one game day – you just might feel better!
zero_mood.offer: Hey emo kid! Looks like too much black has got your mood to zero!  <split butt_txt="What on Ur are you on about?" /> You’re dark! Dark in the heart!  Go hug 33 different players to assuage that inner torment.  But hurry, you only have ‘til breaking dawn!
zero_mood.completion: Didn’t I tell you you’d chirk right up? You know what they say about hugs per day!
